text_en: God , who, at sundry times and in divers manners, spoke in times past to the fathers by the prophets , last of all,
text_la: Multifariam, multisque modis olim Deus loquens patribus in prophetis:
text_pt: Havendo Deus antigamente falado muitas vezes, e de muitas maneiras, aos pais, pelos profetas, a nós falou-nos nestes últimos dias pelo Filho,
text_el: Πολυμερῶς καὶ πολυτρόπως πάλαι ὁ θεὸς λαλήσας τοῖς πατράσιν ἐν τοῖς προφήταις

text_en: in these days, has spoken to us by his Son , whom he has appointed heir of all things, by whom also he made the world.
text_la: novissime, diebus istis locutus est nobis in Filio, quem constituit hæredem universorum, per quem fecit et sæcula:
text_pt: A quem constituiu herdeiro de tudo, por quem fez também o mundo.
text_el: ἐπ' ἐσχάτου τῶν ἡμερῶν τούτων ἐλάλησεν ἡμῖν ἐν υἱῷ, ὃν ἔθηκεν κληρονόμον πάντων, δι' οὗ καὶ ἐποίησεν τοὺς αἰῶνας:

text_en: Who being the brightness of his glory and the figure of his substance and upholding all things by the word of his power, making purgation of sins , sits on the right hand of the majesty on high :
text_la: qui cum sit splendor gloriæ, et figura substantiæ ejus, portansque omnia verbo virtutis suæ, purgationem peccatorum faciens, sedet ad dexteram majestatis in excelsis:
text_pt: O qual, sendo o resplendor da sua glória, e a expressa imagem da sua pessoa, e sustentando todas as coisas pela palavra do seu poder, havendo feito por si mesmo a purificação dos nossos pecados, assentou-se à destra da majestade nas alturas;
text_el: ὃς ὢν ἀπαύγασμα τῆς δόξης καὶ χαρακτὴρ τῆς ὑποστάσεως αὐτοῦ, φέρων τε τὰ πάντα τῷ ῥήματι τῆς δυνάμεως αὐτοῦ, καθαρισμὸν τῶν ἁμαρτιῶν ποιησάμενος ἐκάθισεν ἐν δεξιᾷ τῆς μεγαλωσύνης ἐν ὑψηλοῖς,

text_en: Being made so much better than the angels as he has inherited a more excellent name than they.
text_la: tanto melior angelis effectus, quanto differentius præ illis nomen hæreditavit.
text_pt: Feito tanto mais excelente do que os anjos, quanto herdou mais excelente nome do que eles.
text_el: τοσούτῳ κρείττων γενόμενος τῶν ἀγγέλων ὅσῳ διαφορώτερον παρ' αὐτοὺς κεκληρονόμηκεν ὄνομα.

text_en: For to which of the angels has he said at any time: You are my Son , today have I begotten you? And again: I will be to him a Father, and he shall be to me a Son ?
text_la: Cui enim dixit aliquando angelorum : Filius meus es tu, ego hodie genui te? Et rursum : Ego ero illi in patrem, et ipse erit mihi in filium?
text_pt: Porque, a qual dos anjos disse jamais: Tu és meu Filho, Hoje te gerei? E outra vez: Eu lhe serei por Pai, E ele me será por Filho?
text_el: τίνι γὰρ εἶπέν ποτε τῶν ἀγγέλων, υἱός μου εἶ σύ, ἐγὼ σήμερον γεγέννηκά σε; καὶ πάλιν, ἐγὼ ἔσομαι αὐτῷ εἰς πατέρα, καὶ αὐτὸς ἔσται μοι εἰς υἱόν;

text_en: And again, when he brings in the first begotten into the world, he says: And let all the angels of God adore him.
text_la: Et cum iterum introducit primogenitum in orbem terræ, dicit : Et adorent eum omnes angeli Dei.
text_pt: E outra vez, quando introduz no mundo o primogênito, diz:E todos os anjos de Deus o adorem.
text_el: ὅταν δὲ πάλιν εἰσαγάγῃ τὸν πρωτότοκον εἰς τὴν οἰκουμένην, λέγει, καὶ προσκυνησάτωσαν αὐτῷ πάντες ἄγγελοι θεοῦ.

text_en: And to the angels indeed he says: He that makes his angels spirits and his ministers a flame of fire.
text_la: Et ad angelos quidem dicit : Qui facit angelos suos spiritus, et ministros suos flammam ignis.
text_pt: E, quanto aos anjos, diz: Faz dos seus anjos espíritos, E de seus ministros labareda de fogo.
text_el: καὶ πρὸς μὲν τοὺς ἀγγέλους λέγει, ὁ ποιῶν τοὺς ἀγγέλους αὐτοῦ πνεύματα, καὶ τοὺς λειτουργοὺς αὐτοῦ πυρὸς φλόγα:

text_en: But to the Son : Your throne, O God , is for ever and ever: a sceptre of justice is the sceptre of your kingdom .
text_la: Ad Filium autem : Thronus tuus Deus in sæculum sæculi : virga æquitatis, virga regni tui.
text_pt: Mas, do Filho, diz: Ó Deus, o teu trono subsiste pelos séculos dos séculos; Cetro de eqüidade é o cetro do teu reino.
text_el: πρὸς δὲ τὸν υἱόν, ὁ θρόνος σου, ὁ θεός, εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα [τοῦ αἰῶνος], καὶ ἡ ῥάβδος τῆς εὐθύτητος ῥάβδος τῆς βασιλείας αὐτοῦ.

text_en: You have loved justice and hated iniquity : therefore God , your God , has anointed you with the oil of gladness above your fellows.
text_la: Dilexisti justitiam, et odisti iniquitatem : propterea unxit te Deus, Deus tuus, oleo exultationis præ participibus tuis.
text_pt: Amaste a justiça e odiaste a iniqüidade; por isso Deus, o teu Deus, te ungiuCom óleo de alegria mais do que a teus companheiros.
text_el: ἠγάπησας δικαιοσύνην καὶ ἐμίσησας ἀνομίαν: διὰ τοῦτο ἔχρισέν σε ὁ θεός, ὁ θεός σου, ἔλαιον ἀγαλλιάσεως παρὰ τοὺς μετόχους σου:

text_en: And: You in the beginning, O Lord , founded the earth : and the works of your hands are the heavens.
text_la: Et : Tu in principio, Domine, terram fundasti : et opera manuum tuarum sunt cæli.
text_pt: E: Tu, Senhor, no princípio fundaste a terra, E os céus são obra de tuas mãos.
text_el: καί, σὺ κατ' ἀρχάς, κύριε, τὴν γῆν ἐθεμελίωσας, καὶ ἔργα τῶν χειρῶν σού εἰσιν οἱ οὐρανοί:

text_en: They shall perish: but you shall continue: and they shall all grow old as a garment.
text_la: Ipsi peribunt, tu autem permanebis, et omnes ut vestimentum veterascent:
text_pt: Eles perecerão, mas tu permanecerás; E todos eles, como roupa, envelhecerão,
text_el: αὐτοὶ ἀπολοῦνται, σὺ δὲ διαμένεις: καὶ πάντες ὡς ἱμάτιον παλαιωθήσονται,

text_en: And as a vesture shall you change them, and they shall be changed. But you are the selfsame: and your years shall not fail.
text_la: et velut amictum mutabis eos, et mutabuntur : tu autem idem ipse es, et anni tui non deficient.
text_pt: E como um manto os enrolarás, e serão mudados. Mas tu és o mesmo, E os teus anos não acabarão.
text_el: καὶ ὡσεὶ περιβόλαιον ἑλίξεις αὐτούς, ὡς ἱμάτιον καὶ ἀλλαγήσονται, σὺ δὲ ὁ αὐτὸς εἶ καὶ τὰ ἔτη σου οὐκ ἐκλείψουσιν.

text_en: But to which of the angels said he at any time: Sit on my right hand, until I make your enemies your footstool?
text_la: Ad quem autem angelorum dixit aliquando : Sede a dextris meis, quoadusque ponam inimicos tuos scabellum pedum tuorum?
text_pt: E a qual dos anjos disse jamais: Assenta-te à minha destra, Até que ponha a teus inimigos por escabelo de teus pés?
text_el: πρὸς τίνα δὲ τῶν ἀγγέλων εἴρηκέν ποτε, κάθου ἐκ δεξιῶν μου ἕως ἂν θῶ τοὺς ἐχθρούς σου ὑποπόδιον τῶν ποδῶν σου;

text_en: Are they not all ministering spirits , sent to minister for them who shall receive the inheritance of salvation ?
text_la: Nonne omnes sunt administratorii spiritus, in ministerium missi propter eos, qui hæreditatem capient salutis?
text_pt: Não são porventura todos eles espíritos ministradores, enviados para servir a favor daqueles que hão de herdar a salvação?
text_el: οὐχὶ πάντες εἰσὶν λειτουργικὰ πνεύματα εἰς διακονίαν ἀποστελλόμενα διὰ τοὺς μέλλοντας κληρονομεῖν σωτηρίαν;

text_en: Therefore ought we more diligently to observe the things which we have heard lest perhaps we should let them slip.
text_la: Propterea abundantius oportet observare nos ea quæ audivimus, ne forte pereffluamus.
text_pt: Portanto, convém-nos atentar com mais diligência para as coisas que já temos ouvido, para que em tempo algum nos desviemos delas.
text_el: Διὰ τοῦτο δεῖ περισσοτέρως προσέχειν ἡμᾶς τοῖς ἀκουσθεῖσιν, μήποτε παραρυῶμεν.

text_en: For if the word spoken by angels became steadfast and every transgression and disobedience received a just recompense of reward:
text_la: Si enim qui per angelos dictus est sermo, factus est firmus, et omnis prævaricatio, et inobedientia accepit justam mercedis retributionem:
text_pt: Porque, se a palavra falada pelos anjos permaneceu firme, e toda a transgressão e desobediência recebeu a justa retribuição,
text_el: εἰ γὰρ ὁ δι' ἀγγέλων λαληθεὶς λόγος ἐγένετο βέβαιος, καὶ πᾶσα παράβασις καὶ παρακοὴ ἔλαβεν ἔνδικον μισθαποδοσίαν,

text_en: How shall we escape if we neglect so great salvation ? Which, having begun to be declared by the Lord , was confirmed unto us by them that heard him.
text_la: quomodo nos effugiemus si tantam neglexerimus salutem? quæ cum initium accepisset enarrari per Dominum ab eis, qui audierunt, in nos confirmata est,
text_pt: Como escaparemos nós, se não atentarmos para uma tão grande salvação, a qual, começando a ser anunciada pelo Senhor, foi-nos depois confirmada pelos que a ouviram;
text_el: πῶς ἡμεῖς ἐκφευξόμεθα τηλικαύτης ἀμελήσαντες σωτηρίας; ἥτις, ἀρχὴν λαβοῦσα λαλεῖσθαι διὰ τοῦ κυρίου, ὑπὸ τῶν ἀκουσάντων εἰς ἡμᾶς ἐβεβαιώθη,

text_en: God also bearing them witness by signs and wonders and divers miracles and distributions of the Holy Ghost , according to his own will.
text_la: contestante Deo signis et portentis, et variis virtutibus, et Spiritus Sancti distributionibus secundum suam voluntatem.
text_pt: Testificando também Deus com eles, por sinais, e milagres, e várias maravilhas e dons do Espírito Santo, distribuídos por sua vontade?
text_el: συνεπιμαρτυροῦντος τοῦ θεοῦ σημείοις τε καὶ τέρασιν καὶ ποικίλαις δυνάμεσιν καὶ πνεύματος ἁγίου μερισμοῖς κατὰ τὴν αὐτοῦ θέλησιν.

text_en: For God has not subjected unto angels the world to come, whereof we speak.
text_la: Non enim angelis subjecit Deus orbem terræ futurum, de quo loquimur.
text_pt: Porque não foi aos anjos que sujeitou o mundo futuro, de que falamos.
text_el: Οὐ γὰρ ἀγγέλοις ὑπέταξεν τὴν οἰκουμένην τὴν μέλλουσαν, περὶ ἧς λαλοῦμεν.

text_en: But one in a certain place has testified, saying: What is man , that you are mindful of him? Or the son of man , that you visit him?
text_la: Testatus est autem in quodam loco quis, dicens : Quid est homo quod memor es ejus, aut filius hominis quoniam visitas eum?
text_pt: Mas em certo lugar testificou alguém, dizendo:Que é o homem, para que dele te lembres?Ou o filho do homem, para que o visites?
text_el: διεμαρτύρατο δέ πού τις λέγων, τί ἐστιν ἄνθρωπος ὅτι μιμνῄσκῃ αὐτοῦ, ἢ υἱὸς ἀνθρώπου ὅτι ἐπισκέπτῃ αὐτόν;

text_en: You have made him a little lower than the angels : you have crowned him with glory and honour and have set him over the works of your hands.
text_la: Minuisti eum paulo minus ab angelis : gloria et honore coronasti eum : et constituisti eum super opera manuum tuarum.
text_pt: Tu o fizeste um pouco menor do que os anjos,De glória e de honra o coroaste,E o constituíste sobre as obras de tuas mãos;
text_el: ἠλάττωσας αὐτὸν βραχύ τι παρ' ἀγγέλους, δόξῃ καὶ τιμῇ ἐστεφάνωσας αὐτόν, [καὶ κατέστησας αὐτὸν ἐπὶ τὰ ἔργα τῶν χειρῶν σου]

text_en: You have subjected all things under his feet. For in that he has subjected all things to him he left nothing not subject to him. But now we see not as yet all things subject to him.
text_la: Omnia subjecisti sub pedibus ejus. In eo enim quod omnia ei subjecit, nihil dimisit non subjectum ei. Nunc autem necdum videmus omnia subjecta ei.
text_pt: Todas as coisas lhe sujeitaste debaixo dos pés.Ora, visto que lhe sujeitou todas as coisas, nada deixou que lhe não esteja sujeito. Mas agora ainda não vemos que todas as coisas lhe estejam sujeitas.
text_el: πάντα ὑπέταξας ὑποκάτω τῶν ποδῶν αὐτοῦ. ἐν τῷ γὰρ ὑποτάξαι αὐτῷ τὰ πάντα οὐδὲν ἀφῆκεν αὐτῷ ἀνυπότακτον. νῦν δὲ οὔπω ὁρῶμεν αὐτῷ τὰ πάντα ὑποτεταγμένα:

text_en: But we see Jesus , who was made a little lower than the angels , for the suffering of death, crowned with glory and honour : that, through the grace of God he might taste death for all.
text_la: Eum autem, qui modico quam angeli minoratus est, videmus Jesum propter passionem mortis, gloria et honore coronatum : ut, gratia Dei, pro omnibus gustaret mortem.
text_pt: Vemos, porém, coroado de glória e de honra aquele Jesus que fora feito um pouco menor do que os anjos, por causa da paixão da morte, para que, pela graça de Deus, provasse a morte por todos.
text_el: τὸν δὲ βραχύ τι παρ' ἀγγέλους ἠλαττωμένον βλέπομεν Ἰησοῦν διὰ τὸ πάθημα τοῦ θανάτου δόξῃ καὶ τιμῇ ἐστεφανωμένον, ὅπως χάριτι θεοῦ ὑπὲρ παντὸς γεύσηται θανάτου.

text_en: For it became him for whom are all things and by whom are all things, who had brought many children into glory , to perfect the author of their salvation , by his passion .
text_la: Decebat enim eum, propter quem omnia, et per quem omnia, qui multos filios in gloriam adduxerat, auctorem salutis eorum per passionem consummare.
text_pt: Porque convinha que aquele, para quem são todas as coisas, e mediante quem tudo existe, trazendo muitos filhos à glória, consagrasse pelas aflições o príncipe da salvação deles.
text_el: ἔπρεπεν γὰρ αὐτῷ, δι' ὃν τὰ πάντα καὶ δι' οὗ τὰ πάντα, πολλοὺς υἱοὺς εἰς δόξαν ἀγαγόντα τὸν ἀρχηγὸν τῆς σωτηρίας αὐτῶν διὰ παθημάτων τελειῶσαι.

text_en: For both he that sanctifies and they who are sanctified are all of one. For which cause he is not ashamed to call them brethren, saying:
text_la: Qui enim sanctificat, et qui sanctificantur, ex uno omnes. Propter quam causam non confunditur fratres eos vocare, dicens:
text_pt: Porque, assim o que santifica, como os que são santificados, são todos de um; por cuja causa não se envergonha de lhes chamar irmãos,
text_el: ὁ τε γὰρ ἁγιάζων καὶ οἱ ἁγιαζόμενοι ἐξ ἑνὸς πάντες: δι' ἣν αἰτίαν οὐκ ἐπαισχύνεται ἀδελφοὺς αὐτοὺς καλεῖν,

text_en: I will declare your name to my brethren: in the midst of the church will I praise you.
text_la: Nuntiabo nomen tuum fratribus meis : in medio ecclesiæ laudabo te.
text_pt: Dizendo:Anunciarei o teu nome a meus irmãos,Cantar-te-ei louvores no meio da congregação.
text_el: λέγων, ἀπαγγελῶ τὸ ὄνομά σου τοῖς ἀδελφοῖς μου, ἐν μέσῳ ἐκκλησίας ὑμνήσω σε:

text_en: And again: I will put my trust in him. And again: Behold I and my children, whom God has given me.
text_la: Et iterum : Ego ero fidens in eum. Et iterum : Ecce ego, et pueri mei, quos dedit mihi Deus.
text_pt: E outra vez: Porei nele a minha confiança. E outra vez: Eis-me aqui a mim, e aos filhos que Deus me deu.
text_el: καὶ πάλιν, ἐγὼ ἔσομαι πεποιθὼς ἐπ' αὐτῷ: καὶ πάλιν, ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ καὶ τὰ παιδία ἅ μοι ἔδωκεν ὁ θεός.

text_en: Therefore because the children are partakers of flesh and blood, he also himself in like manner has been partaker of the same: that, through death, he might destroy him who had the empire of death, that is to say, the devil :
text_la: Quia ergo pueri communicaverunt carni, et sanguini, et ipse similiter participavit eisdem : ut per mortem destrueret eum qui habebat mortis imperium, id est, diabolum:
text_pt: E, visto como os filhos participam da carne e do sangue, também ele participou das mesmas coisas, para que pela morte aniquilasse o que tinha o império da morte, isto é, o diabo;
text_el: ἐπεὶ οὖν τὰ παιδία κεκοινώνηκεν αἵματος καὶ σαρκός, καὶ αὐτὸς παραπλησίως μετέσχεν τῶν αὐτῶν, ἵνα διὰ τοῦ θανάτου καταργήσῃ τὸν τὸ κράτος ἔχοντα τοῦ θανάτου, τοῦτ' ἔστιν τὸν διάβολον,

text_en: And might deliver them, who through the fear of death were all their lifetime subject to servitude.
text_la: et liberaret eos qui timore mortis per totam vitam obnoxii erant servituti.
text_pt: E livrasse todos os que, com medo da morte, estavam por toda a vida sujeitos à servidão.
text_el: καὶ ἀπαλλάξῃ τούτους, ὅσοι φόβῳ θανάτου διὰ παντὸς τοῦ ζῆν ἔνοχοι ἦσαν δουλείας.

text_en: For nowhere does he take hold of the angels : but of the seed of Abraham he takes hold.
text_la: Nusquam enim angelos apprehendit, sed semen Abrahæ apprehendit.
text_pt: Porque, na verdade, ele não tomou os anjos, mas tomou a descendência de Abraão.
text_el: οὐ γὰρ δήπου ἀγγέλων ἐπιλαμβάνεται, ἀλλὰ σπέρματος Ἀβραὰμ ἐπιλαμβάνεται.

text_en: Wherefore, it behoved him in all things to be made like unto his brethren, that he might become a merciful and faithful high priest before God , that he might be a propitiation for the sins of the people.
text_la: Unde debuit per omnia fratribus similari, ut misericors fieret, et fidelis pontifex ad Deum, ut repropitiaret delicta populi.
text_pt: Por isso convinha que em tudo fosse semelhante aos irmãos, para ser misericordioso e fiel sumo sacerdote naquilo que é de Deus, para expiar os pecados do povo.
text_el: ὅθεν ὤφειλεν κατὰ πάντα τοῖς ἀδελφοῖς ὁμοιωθῆναι, ἵνα ἐλεήμων γένηται καὶ πιστὸς ἀρχιερεὺς τὰ πρὸς τὸν θεόν, εἰς τὸ ἱλάσκεσθαι τὰς ἁμαρτίας τοῦ λαοῦ:

text_en: For in that wherein he himself has suffered and been tempted he is able to succour them also that are tempted .
text_la: In eo enim, in quo passus est ipse et tentatus, potens est et eis, qui tentantur, auxiliari.
text_pt: Porque naquilo que ele mesmo, sendo tentado, padeceu, pode socorrer aos que são tentados.
text_el: ἐν ᾧ γὰρ πέπονθεν αὐτὸς πειρασθείς, δύναται τοῖς πειραζομένοις βοηθῆσαι.

text_en: Wherefore, holy brethren, partakers of the heavenly vocation consider the apostle and high priest of our confession, Jesus :
text_la: Unde, fratres sancti, vocationis cælestis participes, considerate Apostolum, et pontificem confessionis nostræ Jesum:
text_pt: Por isso, irmãos santos, participantes da vocação celestial, considerai a Jesus Cristo, apóstolo e sumo sacerdote da nossa confissão,
text_el: ὅθεν, ἀδελφοὶ ἅγιοι, κλήσεως ἐπουρανίου μέτοχοι, κατανοήσατε τὸν ἀπόστολον καὶ ἀρχιερέα τῆς ὁμολογίας ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦν,

text_en: Who is faithful to him that made him, as was also Moses in all his house.
text_la: qui fidelis est ei, qui fecit illum, sicut et Moyses in omni domo ejus.
text_pt: Sendo fiel ao que o constituiu, como também o foi Moisés em toda a sua casa.
text_el: πιστὸν ὄντα τῷ ποιήσαντι αὐτὸν ὡς καὶ Μωϋσῆς ἐν ὅλῳ τῷ οἴκῳ αὐτοῦ.

text_en: For this man was counted worthy of greater glory than Moses , by so much as he that has built the house has greater honour than the house.
text_la: Amplioris enim gloriæ iste præ Moyse dignus est habitus, quanto ampliorem honorem habet domus, qui fabricavit illam.
text_pt: Porque ele é tido por digno de tanto maior glória do que Moisés, quanto maior honra do que a casa tem aquele que a edificou.
text_el: πλείονος γὰρ οὗτος δόξης παρὰ Μωϋσῆν ἠξίωται καθ' ὅσον πλείονα τιμὴν ἔχει τοῦ οἴκου ὁ κατασκευάσας αὐτόν.

text_en: For every house is built by some man : but he that created all things is God .
text_la: Omnis namque domus fabricatur ab aliquo : qui autem omnia creavit, Deus est.
text_pt: Porque toda a casa é edificada por alguém, mas o que edificou todas as coisas é Deus.
text_el: πᾶς γὰρ οἶκος κατασκευάζεται ὑπό τινος, ὁ δὲ πάντα κατασκευάσας θεός.

text_en: And Moses indeed was faithful in all his house as a servant, for a testimony of those things which were to be said:
text_la: Et Moyses quidem fidelis erat in tota domo ejus tamquam famulus, in testimonium eorum, quæ dicenda erant:
text_pt: E, na verdade, Moisés foi fiel em toda a sua casa, como servo, para testemunho das coisas que se haviam de anunciar;
text_el: καὶ Μωϋσῆς μὲν πιστὸς ἐν ὅλῳ τῷ οἴκῳ αὐτοῦ ὡς θεράπων εἰς μαρτύριον τῶν λαληθησομένων,

text_en: But Christ , as the Son in his own house: which house are we, if we hold fast the confidence and glory of hope unto the end.
text_la: Christus vero tamquam filius in domo sua : quæ domus sumus nos, si fiduciam, et gloriam spei usque ad finem, firmam retineamus.
text_pt: Mas Cristo, como Filho, sobre a sua própria casa; a qual casa somos nós, se tão somente conservarmos firme a confiança e a glória da esperança até ao fim.
text_el: Χριστὸς δὲ ὡς υἱὸς ἐπὶ τὸν οἶκον αὐτοῦ, οὗ οἶκός ἐσμεν ἡμεῖς, ἐὰν τὴν παρρησίαν καὶ τὸ καύχημα τῆς ἐλπίδος [μέχρι τέλους βεβαίαν] κατάσχωμεν.

text_en: Wherefore, as the Holy Ghost says: Today if you shall hear his voice,
text_la: Quapropter sicut dicit Spiritus Sanctus: Hodie si vocem ejus audieritis,
text_pt: Portanto, como diz o Espírito Santo: Se ouvirdes hoje a sua voz,
text_el: διό, καθὼς λέγει τὸ πνεῦμα τὸ ἅγιον, σήμερον ἐὰν τῆς φωνῆς αὐτοῦ ἀκούσητε,

text_en: harden not your hearts, as in the provocation, in the day of temptation in the desert ,
text_la: nolite obdurare corda vestra, sicut in exacerbatione secundum diem tentationis in deserto,
text_pt: Não endureçais os vossos corações,Como na provocação, no dia da tentação no deserto.
text_el: μὴ σκληρύνητε τὰς καρδίας ὑμῶν ὡς ἐν τῷ παραπικρασμῷ, κατὰ τὴν ἡμέραν τοῦ πειρασμοῦ ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ,

text_en: where your fathers tempted me, proved and saw my works ,
text_la: ubi tentaverunt me patres vestri : probaverunt, et viderunt opera mea
text_pt: Onde vossos pais me tentaram, me provaram,E viram por quarenta anos as minhas obras.
text_el: οὗ ἐπείρασαν οἱ πατέρες ὑμῶν ἐν δοκιμασίᾳ καὶ εἶδον τὰ ἔργα μου

text_en: forty years: for which cause I was offended with this generation , and I said: They always err in heart. And they have not known my ways.
text_la: quadraginta annis : propter quod infensus fui generationi huic, et dixi : Semper errant corde. Ipsi autem non cognoverunt vias meas,
text_pt: Por isso me indignei contra esta geração, E disse: Estes sempre erram em seu coração, E não conheceram os meus caminhos.
text_el: τεσσεράκοντα ἔτη: διὸ προσώχθισα τῇ γενεᾷ ταύτῃ καὶ εἶπον, ἀεὶ πλανῶνται τῇ καρδίᾳ: αὐτοὶ δὲ οὐκ ἔγνωσαν τὰς ὁδούς μου,

text_en: As I have sworn in my wrath : If they shall enter into my rest.
text_la: sicut juravi in ira mea : Si introibunt in requiem meam.
text_pt: Assim jurei na minha ira Que não entrarão no meu repouso.
text_el: ὡς ὤμοσα ἐν τῇ ὀργῇ μου, εἰ εἰσελεύσονται εἰς τὴν κατάπαυσίν μου.

text_en: Take heed, brethren, lest perhaps there be in any of you an evil heart of unbelief, to depart from the living God .
text_la: Videte fratres, ne forte sit in aliquo vestrum cor malum incredulitatis, discedendi a Deo vivo:
text_pt: Vede, irmãos, que nunca haja em qualquer de vós um coração mau e infiel, para se apartar do Deus vivo.
text_el: βλέπετε, ἀδελφοί, μήποτε ἔσται ἔν τινι ὑμῶν καρδία πονηρὰ ἀπιστίας ἐν τῷ ἀποστῆναι ἀπὸ θεοῦ ζῶντος,

text_en: But exhort one another every day, whilst it is called to day, that none of you be hardened through the deceitfulness of sin .
text_la: sed adhortamini vosmetipsos per singulos dies, donec hodie cognominatur, ut non obduretur quis ex vobis fallacia peccati.
text_pt: Antes, exortai-vos uns aos outros todos os dias, durante o tempo que se chama Hoje, para que nenhum de vós se endureça pelo engano do pecado;
text_el: ἀλλὰ παρακαλεῖτε ἑαυτοὺς καθ' ἑκάστην ἡμέραν, ἄχρις οὗ τὸ σήμερον καλεῖται, ἵνα μὴ σκληρυνθῇ τις ἐξ ὑμῶν ἀπάτῃ τῆς ἁμαρτίας:

text_en: For we are made partakers of Christ : yet so, if we hold the beginning of his substance firm unto the end.
text_la: Participes enim Christi effecti sumus, si tamen initium substantiæ ejus usque ad finem firmum retineamus.
text_pt: Porque nos tornamos participantes de Cristo, se retivermos firmemente o princípio da nossa confiança até ao fim.
text_el: μέτοχοι γὰρ τοῦ Χριστοῦ γεγόναμεν, ἐάνπερ τὴν ἀρχὴν τῆς ὑποστάσεως μέχρι τέλους βεβαίαν κατάσχωμεν,

text_en: While it is said: To day, if you shall hear his voice, harden not your hearts, as in that provocation.
text_la: Dum dicitur : Hodie si vocem ejus audieritis, nolite obdurare corda vestra, quemadmodum in illa exacerbatione.
text_pt: Enquanto se diz: Hoje, se ouvirdes a sua voz, Não endureçais os vossos corações, como na provocação.
text_el: ἐν τῷ λέγεσθαι, σήμερον ἐὰν τῆς φωνῆς αὐτοῦ ἀκούσητε, μὴ σκληρύνητε τὰς καρδίας ὑμῶν ὡς ἐν τῷ παραπικρασμῷ.

text_en: For some who heard did provoke: but not all that came out of Egypt by Moses .
text_la: Quidam enim audientes exacerbaverunt : sed non universi qui profecti sunt ex Ægypto per Moysen.
text_pt: Porque, havendo-a alguns ouvido, o provocaram; mas não todos os que saíram do Egito por meio de Moisés.
text_el: τίνες γὰρ ἀκούσαντες παρεπίκραναν; ἀλλ' οὐ πάντες οἱ ἐξελθόντες ἐξ Αἰγύπτου διὰ Μωϋσέως;

text_en: And with whom was he offended forty years? Was it not with them that sinned , whose carcasses were overthrown in the desert ?
text_la: Quibus autem infensus est quadraginta annis? nonne illis qui peccaverunt, quorum cadavera prostrata sunt in deserto?
text_pt: Mas com quem se indignou por quarenta anos? Não foi porventura com os que pecaram, cujos corpos caíram no deserto?
text_el: τίσιν δὲ προσώχθισεν τεσσεράκοντα ἔτη; οὐχὶ τοῖς ἁμαρτήσασιν, ὧν τὰ κῶλα ἔπεσεν ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ;

text_en: And to whom did he swear , that they should not enter into his rest: but to them that were incredulous?
text_la: Quibus autem juravit non introire in requiem ipsius, nisi illis qui increduli fuerunt?
text_pt: E a quem jurou que não entrariam no seu repouso, senão aos que foram desobedientes?
text_el: τίσιν δὲ ὤμοσεν μὴ εἰσελεύσεσθαι εἰς τὴν κατάπαυσιν αὐτοῦ εἰ μὴ τοῖς ἀπειθήσασιν;

text_en: And we see that they could not enter in, because of unbelief.
text_la: Et videmus, quia non potuerunt introire propter incredulitatem.
text_pt: E vemos que não puderam entrar por causa da sua incredulidade.
text_el: καὶ βλέπομεν ὅτι οὐκ ἠδυνήθησαν εἰσελθεῖν δι' ἀπιστίαν.

text_en: Let us fear therefore lest, the promise being left of entering into his rest, any of you should be thought to be wanting.
text_la: Timeamus ergo ne forte relicta pollicitatione introëundi in requiem ejus, existimetur aliquis ex vobis deesse.
text_pt: Temamos, pois, que, porventura, deixada a promessa de entrar no seu repouso, pareça que algum de vós fica para trás.
text_el: Φοβηθῶμεν οὖν μήποτε καταλειπομένης ἐπαγγελίας εἰσελθεῖν εἰς τὴν κατάπαυσιν αὐτοῦ δοκῇ τις ἐξ ὑμῶν ὑστερηκέναι:

text_en: For unto us also it has been declared in like manner as unto them. But the word of hearing did not profit them, not being mixed with faith of those things they heard.
text_la: Etenim et nobis nuntiatum est, quemadmodum et illis : sed non profuit illis sermo auditus, non admistus fidei ex iis quæ audierunt.
text_pt: Porque também a nós foram pregadas as boas novas, como a eles, mas a palavra da pregação nada lhes aproveitou, porquanto não estava misturada com a fé naqueles que a ouviram.
text_el: καὶ γάρ ἐσμεν εὐηγγελισμένοι καθάπερ κἀκεῖνοι, ἀλλ' οὐκ ὠφέλησεν ὁ λόγος τῆς ἀκοῆς ἐκείνους, μὴ συγκεκερασμένους τῇ πίστει τοῖς ἀκούσασιν.

text_en: For we, who have believed , shall enter into rest; as he said: As I have sworn in my wrath : If they shall enter into my rest; and this indeed when the works from the foundation of the world were finished.
text_la: Ingrediemur enim in requiem, qui credidimus : quemadmodum dixit : Sicut juravi in ira mea : Si introibunt in requiem meam : et quidem operibus ab institutione mundi perfectis.
text_pt: Porque nós, os que temos crido, entramos no repouso, tal como disse:Assim jurei na minha ira Que não entrarão no meu repouso; embora as suas obras estivessem acabadas desde a fundação do mundo.
text_el: εἰσερχόμεθα γὰρ εἰς τὴν κατάπαυσιν οἱ πιστεύσαντες, καθὼς εἴρηκεν, ὡς ὤμοσα ἐν τῇ ὀργῇ μου, εἰ εἰσελεύσονται εἰς τὴν κατάπαυσίν μου, καίτοι τῶν ἔργων ἀπὸ καταβολῆς κόσμου γενηθέντων.

text_en: For in a certain place he spoke of the seventh day thus: And God rested the seventh day from all his works .
text_la: Dixit enim in quodam loco de die septima sic : Et requievit Deus die septima ab omnibus operibus suis.
text_pt: Porque em certo lugar disse assim do dia sétimo: E repousou Deus de todas as suas obras no sétimo dia.
text_el: εἴρηκεν γάρ που περὶ τῆς ἑβδόμης οὕτως, καὶ κατέπαυσεν ὁ θεὸς ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ ἑβδόμῃ ἀπὸ πάντων τῶν ἔργων αὐτοῦ:

text_en: And in this place again: If they shall enter into my rest.
text_la: Et in isto rursum : Si introibunt in requiem meam.
text_pt: E outra vez neste lugar:Não entrarão no meu repouso.
text_el: καὶ ἐν τούτῳ πάλιν, εἰ εἰσελεύσονται εἰς τὴν κατάπαυσίν μου.

text_en: Seeing then it remains that some are to enter into it, and they to whom it was first preached did not enter because of unbelief:
text_la: Quoniam ergo superest introire quosdam in illam, et ii, quibus prioribus annuntiatum est, non introierunt propter incredulitatem:
text_pt: Visto, pois, que resta que alguns entrem nele, e que aqueles a quem primeiro foram pregadas as boas novas não entraram por causa da desobediência,
text_el: ἐπεὶ οὖν ἀπολείπεται τινὰς εἰσελθεῖν εἰς αὐτήν, καὶ οἱ πρότερον εὐαγγελισθέντες οὐκ εἰσῆλθον δι' ἀπείθειαν,

text_en: Again he limits a certain day, saying in David ; Today, after so long a time as it is above said: Today if you shall hear his voice, harden not your hearts.
text_la: iterum terminat diem quemdam, Hodie, in David dicendo, post tantum temporis, sicut supra dictum est : Hodie si vocem ejus audieritis, nolite obdurare corda vestra.
text_pt: Determina outra vez um certo dia, Hoje, dizendo por Davi, muito tempo depois, como está dito: Hoje, se ouvirdes a sua voz, Não endureçais os vossos corações.
text_el: πάλιν τινὰ ὁρίζει ἡμέραν, σήμερον, ἐν Δαυὶδ λέγων μετὰ τοσοῦτον χρόνον, καθὼς προείρηται, σήμερον ἐὰν τῆς φωνῆς αὐτοῦ ἀκούσητε, μὴ σκληρύνητε τὰς καρδίας ὑμῶν.

text_en: For if Jesus had given them rest he would never have afterwards spoken of another day.
text_la: Nam si eis Jesus requiem præstitisset, numquam de alia loqueretur, posthac, die.
text_pt: Porque, se Josué lhes houvesse dado repouso, não falaria depois disso de outro dia.
text_el: εἰ γὰρ αὐτοὺς Ἰησοῦς κατέπαυσεν, οὐκ ἂν περὶ ἄλλης ἐλάλει μετὰ ταῦτα ἡμέρας.

text_en: There remains therefore a day of rest for the people of God .
text_la: Itaque relinquitur sabbatismus populo Dei.
text_pt: Portanto, resta ainda um repouso para o povo de Deus.
text_el: ἄρα ἀπολείπεται σαββατισμὸς τῷ λαῷ τοῦ θεοῦ:

text_en: For he that is entered into his rest, the same also has rested from his works , as God did from his.
text_la: Qui enim ingressus est in requiem ejus, etiam ipse requievit ab operibus suis, sicut a suis Deus.
text_pt: Porque aquele que entrou no seu repouso, ele próprio repousou de suas obras, como Deus das suas.
text_el: ὁ γὰρ εἰσελθὼν εἰς τὴν κατάπαυσιν αὐτοῦ καὶ αὐτὸς κατέπαυσεν ἀπὸ τῶν ἔργων αὐτοῦ ὥσπερ ἀπὸ τῶν ἰδίων ὁ θεός.

text_en: Let us hasten therefore to enter into that rest: lest any man fall into the same example of unbelief.
text_la: Festinemus ergo ingredi in illam requiem : ut ne in idipsum quis incidat incredulitatis exemplum.
text_pt: Procuremos, pois, entrar naquele repouso, para que ninguém caia no mesmo exemplo de desobediência.
text_el: σπουδάσωμεν οὖν εἰσελθεῖν εἰς ἐκείνην τὴν κατάπαυσιν, ἵνα μὴ ἐν τῷ αὐτῷ τις ὑποδείγματι πέσῃ τῆς ἀπειθείας.

text_en: For the word of God is living and effectual and more piercing than any two edged sword; and reaching unto the division of the soul and the spirit , of the joints also and the marrow: and is a discerner of the thoughts and intents of the heart.
text_la: Vivus est enim sermo Dei, et efficax et penetrabilior omni gladio ancipiti : et pertingens usque ad divisionem animæ ac spiritus : compagum quoque ac medullarum, et discretor cogitationum et intentionum cordis.
text_pt: Porque a palavra de Deus é viva e eficaz, e mais penetrante do que espada alguma de dois gumes, e penetra até à divisão da alma e do espírito, e das juntas e medulas, e é apta para discernir os pensamentos e intenções do coração.
text_el: ζῶν γὰρ ὁ λόγος τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ ἐνεργὴς καὶ τομώτερος ὑπὲρ πᾶσαν μάχαιραν δίστομον καὶ διϊκνούμενος ἄχρι μερισμοῦ ψυχῆς καὶ πνεύματος, ἁρμῶν τε καὶ μυελῶν, καὶ κριτικὸς ἐνθυμήσεων καὶ ἐννοιῶν καρδίας:

text_en: Neither is there any creature invisible in his sight: but all things are naked and open to his eyes, to whom our speech is.
text_la: Et non est ulla creatura invisibilis in conspectu ejus : omnia autem nuda et aperta sunt oculis ejus, ad quem nobis sermo.
text_pt: E não há criatura alguma encoberta diante dele; antes todas as coisas estão nuas e patentes aos olhos daquele com quem temos de tratar.
text_el: καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν κτίσις ἀφανὴς ἐνώπιον αὐτοῦ, πάντα δὲ γυμνὰ καὶ τετραχηλισμένα τοῖς ὀφθαλμοῖς αὐτοῦ, πρὸς ὃν ἡμῖν ὁ λόγος.

text_en: Having therefore a great high priest that has passed into the heavens , Jesus the Son of God : let us hold fast our confession.
text_la: Habentes ergo pontificem magnum qui penetravit cælos, Jesum Filium Dei, teneamus confessionem.
text_pt: Visto que temos um grande sumo sacerdote, Jesus, Filho de Deus, que penetrou nos céus, retenhamos firmemente a nossa confissão.
text_el: ἔχοντες οὖν ἀρχιερέα μέγαν διεληλυθότα τοὺς οὐρανούς, Ἰησοῦν τὸν υἱὸν τοῦ θεοῦ, κρατῶμεν τῆς ὁμολογίας:

text_en: For we have not a high priest who cannot have compassion on our infirmities: but one tempted in all things like as we are, without sin .
text_la: Non enim habemus pontificem qui non possit compati infirmitatibus nostris: tentatum autem per omnia pro similitudine absque peccato.
text_pt: Porque não temos um sumo sacerdote que não possa compadecer-se das nossas fraquezas; porém, um que, como nós, em tudo foi tentado, mas sem pecado.
text_el: οὐ γὰρ ἔχομεν ἀρχιερέα μὴ δυνάμενον συμπαθῆσαι ταῖς ἀσθενείαις ἡμῶν, πεπειρασμένον δὲ κατὰ πάντα καθ' ὁμοιότητα χωρὶς ἁμαρτίας.

text_en: Let us go therefore with confidence to the throne of grace : that we may obtain mercy and find grace in seasonable aid.
text_la: Adeamus ergo cum fiducia ad thronum gratiæ : ut misericordiam consequamur, et gratiam inveniamus in auxilio opportuno.
text_pt: Cheguemos, pois, com confiança ao trono da graça, para que possamos alcançar misericórdia e achar graça, a fim de sermos ajudados em tempo oportuno.
text_el: προσερχώμεθα οὖν μετὰ παρρησίας τῷ θρόνῳ τῆς χάριτος, ἵνα λάβωμεν ἔλεος καὶ χάριν εὕρωμεν εἰς εὔκαιρον βοήθειαν.

text_en: For every high priest taken from among men is ordained for men in the things that appertain to God , that he may offer up gifts and sacrifices for sins :
text_la: Omnis namque pontifex ex hominibus assumptus, pro hominibus constituitur in iis quæ sunt ad Deum, ut offerat dona, et sacrificia pro peccatis:
text_pt: Porque todo o sumo sacerdote, tomado dentre os homens, é constituído a favor dos homens nas coisas concernentes a Deus, para que ofereça dons e sacrifícios pelos pecados;
text_el: Πᾶς γὰρ ἀρχιερεὺς ἐξ ἀνθρώπων λαμβανόμενος ὑπὲρ ἀνθρώπων καθίσταται τὰ πρὸς τὸν θεόν, ἵνα προσφέρῃ δῶρά [τε] καὶ θυσίας ὑπὲρ ἁμαρτιῶν,

text_en: Who can have compassion on them that are ignorant and that err : because he himself also is compassed with infirmity.
text_la: qui condolere possit iis qui ignorant et errant : quoniam et ipse circumdatus est infirmitate:
text_pt: E possa compadecer-se ternamente dos ignorantes e errados; pois também ele mesmo está rodeado de fraqueza.
text_el: μετριοπαθεῖν δυνάμενος τοῖς ἀγνοοῦσιν καὶ πλανωμένοις, ἐπεὶ καὶ αὐτὸς περίκειται ἀσθένειαν,

text_en: And therefore he ought, as for the people, so also for himself, to offer for sins .
text_la: et propterea debet, quemadmodum pro populo, ita etiam et pro semetipso offerre pro peccatis.
text_pt: E por esta causa deve ele, tanto pelo povo, como também por si mesmo, fazer oferta pelos pecados.
text_el: καὶ δι' αὐτὴν ὀφείλει καθὼς περὶ τοῦ λαοῦ οὕτως καὶ περὶ ἑαυτοῦ προσφέρειν περὶ ἁμαρτιῶν.

text_en: Neither does any man take the honour to himself, but he that is called by God , as Aaron was.
text_la: Nec quisquam sumit sibi honorem, sed qui vocatur a Deo, tamquam Aaron.
text_pt: E ninguém toma para si esta honra, senão o que é chamado por Deus, como Arão.
text_el: καὶ οὐχ ἑαυτῷ τις λαμβάνει τὴν τιμήν, ἀλλὰ καλούμενος ὑπὸ τοῦ θεοῦ, καθώσπερ καὶ Ἀαρών.

text_en: So Christ also did not glorify himself, that he might be made a high priest : but he that said unto him: You are my Son : this day have I begotten you.
text_la: Sic et Christus non semetipsum clarificavit ut pontifex fieret : sed qui locutus est ad eum : Filius meus es tu, ego hodie genui te.
text_pt: Assim também Cristo não se glorificou a si mesmo, para se fazer sumo sacerdote, mas aquele que lhe disse: Tu és meu Filho,Hoje te gerei.
text_el: οὕτως καὶ ὁ Χριστὸς οὐχ ἑαυτὸν ἐδόξασεν γενηθῆναι ἀρχιερέα, ἀλλ' ὁ λαλήσας πρὸς αὐτόν, υἱός μου εἶ σύ, ἐγὼ σήμερον γεγέννηκά σε:

text_en: As he says also in another place: You are a priest for ever, according to the order of Melchisedech .
text_la: Quemadmodum et in alio loco dicit : Tu es sacerdos in æternum, secundum ordinem Melchisedech.
text_pt: Como também diz, noutro lugar: Tu és sacerdote eternamente, Segundo a ordem de Melquisedeque.
text_el: καθὼς καὶ ἐν ἑτέρῳ λέγει, σὺ ἱερεὺς εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα κατὰ τὴν τάξιν Μελχισέδεκ.

text_en: Who in the days of his flesh, with a strong cry and tears, offering up prayers and supplications to him that was able to save him from death, was heard for his reverence.
text_la: Qui in diebus carnis suæ preces, supplicationesque ad eum qui possit illum salvum facere a morte cum clamore valido, et lacrimis offerens, exauditus est pro sua reverentia.
text_pt: O qual, nos dias da sua carne, oferecendo, com grande clamor e lágrimas, orações e súplicas ao que o podia livrar da morte, foi ouvido quanto ao que temia.
text_el: ὃς ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις τῆς σαρκὸς αὐτοῦ, δεήσεις τε καὶ ἱκετηρίας πρὸς τὸν δυνάμενον σῴζειν αὐτὸν ἐκ θανάτου μετὰ κραυγῆς ἰσχυρᾶς καὶ δακρύων προσενέγκας καὶ εἰσακουσθεὶς ἀπὸ τῆς εὐλαβείας,

text_en: And whereas indeed he was the Son of God , he learned obedience by the things which he suffered.
text_la: Et quidem cum esset Filius Dei, didicit ex iis, quæ passus est, obedientiam:
text_pt: Ainda que era Filho, aprendeu a obediência, por aquilo que padeceu.
text_el: καίπερ ὢν υἱὸς ἔμαθεν ἀφ' ὧν ἔπαθεν τὴν ὑπακοήν:

text_en: And being consummated, he became, to all that obey him, the cause of eternal salvation :
text_la: et consummatus, factus est omnibus obtemperantibus sibi, causa salutis æternæ,
text_pt: E, sendo ele consumado, veio a ser a causa da eterna salvação para todos os que lhe obedecem;
text_el: καὶ τελειωθεὶς ἐγένετο πᾶσιν τοῖς ὑπακούουσιν αὐτῷ αἴτιος σωτηρίας αἰωνίου,

text_en: Called by God a high priest , according to the order of Melchisedech .
text_la: appellatus a Deo pontifex juxta ordinem Melchisedech.
text_pt: Chamado por Deus sumo sacerdote, segundo a ordem de Melquisedeque.
text_el: προσαγορευθεὶς ὑπὸ τοῦ θεοῦ ἀρχιερεὺς κατὰ τὴν τάξιν Μελχισέδεκ.

text_en: Of whom we have much to say and hard to be intelligibly uttered: because you have become weak to hear.
text_la: De quo nobis grandis sermo, et ininterpretabilis ad dicendum : quoniam imbecilles facti estis ad audiendum.
text_pt: Do qual muito temos que dizer, de difícil interpretação; porquanto vos fizestes negligentes para ouvir.
text_el: Περὶ οὗ πολὺς ἡμῖν ὁ λόγος καὶ δυσερμήνευτος λέγειν, ἐπεὶ νωθροὶ γεγόνατε ταῖς ἀκοαῖς.

text_en: For whereas for the time you ought to be masters, you have need to be taught again what are the first elements of the words of God : and you have become such as have need of milk and not of strong meat.
text_la: Etenim cum deberetis magistri esse propter tempus, rursum indigetis ut vos doceamini quæ sint elementa exordii sermonum Dei : et facti estis quibus lacte opus sit, non solido cibo.
text_pt: Porque, devendo já ser mestres pelo tempo, ainda necessitais de que se vos torne a ensinar quais sejam os primeiros rudimentos das palavras de Deus; e vos haveis feito tais que necessitais de leite, e não de sólido mantimento.
text_el: καὶ γὰρ ὀφείλοντες εἶναι διδάσκαλοι διὰ τὸν χρόνον, πάλιν χρείαν ἔχετε τοῦ διδάσκειν ὑμᾶς τινὰ τὰ στοιχεῖα τῆς ἀρχῆς τῶν λογίων τοῦ θεοῦ, καὶ γεγόνατε χρείαν ἔχοντες γάλακτος, οὐ στερεᾶς τροφῆς.

text_en: For every one that is a partaker of milk is unskilful in the word of justice : for he is a little child.
text_la: Omnis enim, qui lactis est particeps, expers est sermonis justitiæ : parvulus enim est.
text_pt: Porque qualquer que ainda se alimenta de leite não está experimentado na palavra da justiça, porque é menino.
text_el: πᾶς γὰρ ὁ μετέχων γάλακτος ἄπειρος λόγου δικαιοσύνης, νήπιος γάρ ἐστιν:

text_en: But strong meat is for the perfect : for them who by custom have their senses exercised to the discerning of good and evil .
text_la: Perfectorum autem est solidus cibus : eorum, qui pro consuetudine exercitatos habent sensus ad discretionem boni ac mali.
text_pt: Mas o mantimento sólido é para os perfeitos, os quais, em razão do costume, têm os sentidos exercitados para discernir tanto o bem como o mal.
text_el: τελείων δέ ἐστιν ἡ στερεὰ τροφή, τῶν διὰ τὴν ἕξιν τὰ αἰσθητήρια γεγυμνασμένα ἐχόντων πρὸς διάκρισιν καλοῦ τε καὶ κακοῦ.

text_en: Wherefore, leaving the word of the beginning of Christ , let us go on to things more perfect: not laying again the foundation of penance from dead works and of faith towards God ,
text_la: Quapropter intermittentes inchoationis Christi sermonem, ad perfectiora feramur, non rursum jacientes fundamentum pœnitentiæ ab operibus mortuis, et fidei ad Deum,
text_pt: Por isso, deixando os rudimentos da doutrina de Cristo, prossigamos até à perfeição, não lançando de novo o fundamento do arrependimento de obras mortas e de fé em Deus,
text_el: Διὸ ἀφέντες τὸν τῆς ἀρχῆς τοῦ Χριστοῦ λόγον ἐπὶ τὴν τελειότητα φερώμεθα, μὴ πάλιν θεμέλιον καταβαλλόμενοι μετανοίας ἀπὸ νεκρῶν ἔργων, καὶ πίστεως ἐπὶ θεόν,

text_en: of the doctrine of baptisms and imposition of hands , and of the resurrection of the dead , and of eternal judgment .
text_la: baptismatum doctrinæ, impositionis quoque manuum, ac resurrectionis mortuorum, et judicii æterni.
text_pt: E da doutrina dos batismos, e da imposição das mãos, e da ressurreição dos mortos, e do juízo eterno.
text_el: βαπτισμῶν διδαχὴν, ἐπιθέσεώς τε χειρῶν, ἀναστάσεώς νεκρῶν, καὶ κρίματος αἰωνίου.

text_en: And this will we do, if God permit.
text_la: Et hoc faciemus, si quidem permiserit Deus.
text_pt: E isto faremos, se Deus o permitir.
text_el: καὶ τοῦτο ποιήσομεν ἐάνπερ ἐπιτρέπῃ ὁ θεός.

text_en: For it is impossible for those who were once illuminated, have tasted also the heavenly gift and were made partakers of the Holy Ghost ,
text_la: Impossibile est enim eos qui semel sunt illuminati, gustaverunt etiam donum cæleste, et participes facti sunt Spiritus Sancti,
text_pt: Porque é impossível que os que já uma vez foram iluminados, e provaram o dom celestial, e se fizeram participantes do Espírito Santo,
text_el: ἀδύνατον γὰρ τοὺς ἅπαξ φωτισθέντας, γευσαμένους τε τῆς δωρεᾶς τῆς ἐπουρανίου καὶ μετόχους γενηθέντας πνεύματος ἁγίου

text_en: have moreover tasted the good word of God and the powers of the world to come,
text_la: gustaverunt nihilominus bonum Dei verbum, virtutesque sæculi venturi,
text_pt: E provaram a boa palavra de Deus, e as virtudes do século futuro,
text_el: καὶ καλὸν γευσαμένους θεοῦ ῥῆμα δυνάμεις τε μέλλοντος αἰῶνος,

text_en: and are fallen away: to be renewed again to penance , crucifying again to themselves the Son of God and making him a mockery.
text_la: et prolapsi sunt; rursus renovari ad pœnitentiam, rursum crucifigentes sibimetipsis Filium Dei, et ostentui habentes.
text_pt: E recaíram, sejam outra vez renovados para arrependimento; pois assim, quanto a eles, de novo crucificam o Filho de Deus, e o expõem ao vitupério.
text_el: καὶ παραπεσόντας, πάλιν ἀνακαινίζειν εἰς μετάνοιαν, ἀνασταυροῦντας ἑαυτοῖς τὸν υἱὸν τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ παραδειγματίζοντας.

text_en: For the earth, that drinks in the rain which comes often upon it and brings forth herbs meet for them by whom it is tilled, receives blessing from God .
text_la: Terra enim sæpe venientem super se bibens imbrem, et generans herbam opportunam illis, a quibus colitur, accipit benedictionem a Deo:
text_pt: Porque a terra que embebe a chuva, que muitas vezes cai sobre ela, e produz erva proveitosa para aqueles por quem é lavrada, recebe a bênção de Deus;
text_el: γῆ γὰρ ἡ πιοῦσα τὸν ἐπ' αὐτῆς ἐρχόμενον πολλάκις ὑετόν, καὶ τίκτουσα βοτάνην εὔθετον ἐκείνοις δι' οὓς καὶ γεωργεῖται, μεταλαμβάνει εὐλογίας ἀπὸ τοῦ θεοῦ:

text_en: But that which brings forth thorns and briers is reprobate and very near unto a curse : whose end is to be burnt.
text_la: proferens autem spinas ac tribulos, reproba est, et maledicto proxima : cujus consummatio in combustionem.
text_pt: Mas a que produz espinhos e abrolhos, é reprovada, e perto está da maldição; o seu fim é ser queimada.
text_el: ἐκφέρουσα δὲ ἀκάνθας καὶ τριβόλους ἀδόκιμος καὶ κατάρας ἐγγύς, ἧς τὸ τέλος εἰς καῦσιν.

text_en: But, my dearly beloved, we trust better things of you, and nearer to salvation ; though we speak thus.
text_la: Confidimus autem de vobis dilectissimi meliora, et viciniora saluti : tametsi ita loquimur.
text_pt: Mas de vós, ó amados, esperamos coisas melhores, e coisas que acompanham a salvação, ainda que assim falamos.
text_el: Πεπείσμεθα δὲ περὶ ὑμῶν, ἀγαπητοί, τὰ κρείσσονα καὶ ἐχόμενα σωτηρίας, εἰ καὶ οὕτως λαλοῦμεν:

text_en: For God is not unjust , that he should forget your work and the love which you have shown in his name , you who have ministered and do minister to the saints .
text_la: Non enim injustus Deus, ut obliviscatur operis vestri, et dilectionis, quam ostendistis in nomine ipsius, qui ministrastis sanctis, et ministratis.
text_pt: Porque Deus não é injusto para se esquecer da vossa obra, e do trabalho do amor que para com o seu nome mostrastes, enquanto servistes aos santos; e ainda servis.
text_el: οὐ γὰρ ἄδικος ὁ θεὸς ἐπιλαθέσθαι τοῦ ἔργου ὑμῶν καὶ τῆς ἀγάπης ἧς ἐνεδείξασθε εἰς τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ, διακονήσαντες τοῖς ἁγίοις καὶ διακονοῦντες.

text_en: And we desire that every one of you show forth the same carefulness to the accomplishing of hope unto the end:
text_la: Cupimus autem unumquemque vestrum eamdem ostentare sollicitudinem ad expletionem spei usque in finem:
text_pt: Mas desejamos que cada um de vós mostre o mesmo cuidado até ao fim, para completa certeza da esperança;
text_el: ἐπιθυμοῦμεν δὲ ἕκαστον ὑμῶν τὴν αὐτὴν ἐνδείκνυσθαι σπουδὴν πρὸς τὴν πληροφορίαν τῆς ἐλπίδος ἄχρι τέλους,

text_en: That you become not slothful , but followers of them who through faith and patience shall inherit the promises .
text_la: ut non segnes efficiamini, verum imitatores eorum, qui fide, et patientia hæreditabunt promissiones.
text_pt: Para que vos não façais negligentes, mas sejais imitadores dos que pela fé e paciência herdam as promessas.
text_el: ἵνα μὴ νωθροὶ γένησθε, μιμηταὶ δὲ τῶν διὰ πίστεως καὶ μακροθυμίας κληρονομούντων τὰς ἐπαγγελίας.

text_en: For God making promises to Abraham , because he had no one greater by whom he might swear , swore by himself,
text_la: Abrahæ namque promittens Deus, quoniam neminem habuit, per quem juraret, majorem, juravit per semetipsum,
text_pt: Porque, quando Deus fez a promessa a Abraão, como não tinha outro maior por quem jurasse, jurou por si mesmo,
text_el: τῷ γὰρ Ἀβραὰμ ἐπαγγειλάμενος ὁ θεός, ἐπεὶ κατ' οὐδενὸς εἶχεν μείζονος ὀμόσαι, ὤμοσεν καθ' ἑαυτοῦ,

text_en: saying: Unless blessing I shall bless you and multiplying I shall multiply you.
text_la: dicens : Nisi benedicens benedicam te, et multiplicans multiplicabo te.
text_pt: Dizendo: Certamente, abençoando te abençoarei, e multiplicando te multiplicarei.
text_el: λέγων: εἰ μὴν εὐλογῶν εὐλογήσω σε καὶ πληθύνων πληθυνῶ σε:

text_en: And so patiently enduring he obtained the promise .
text_la: Et sic longanimiter ferens, adeptus est repromissionem.
text_pt: E assim, esperando com paciência, alcançou a promessa.
text_el: καὶ οὕτως μακροθυμήσας ἐπέτυχεν τῆς ἐπαγγελίας.

text_en: For men swear by one greater than themselves: and an oath for confirmation is the end of all their controversy.
text_la: Homines enim per majorem sui jurant : et omnis controversiæ eorum finis, ad confirmationem, est juramentum.
text_pt: Porque os homens certamente juram por alguém superior a eles, e o juramento para confirmação é, para eles, o fim de toda a contenda.
text_el: ἄνθρωποι γὰρ κατὰ τοῦ μείζονος ὀμνύουσιν, καὶ πάσης αὐτοῖς ἀντιλογίας πέρας εἰς βεβαίωσιν ὁ ὅρκος:

text_en: Wherein God , meaning more abundantly to show to the heirs of the promise the immutability of his counsel, interposed an oath :
text_la: In quo abundantius volens Deus ostendere pollicitationis hæredibus, immobilitatem consilii sui, interposuit jusjurandum:
text_pt: Por isso, querendo Deus mostrar mais abundantemente a imutabilidade do seu conselho aos herdeiros da promessa, se interpôs com juramento;
text_el: ἐν ᾧ περισσότερον βουλόμενος ὁ θεὸς ἐπιδεῖξαι τοῖς κληρονόμοις τῆς ἐπαγγελίας τὸ ἀμετάθετον τῆς βουλῆς αὐτοῦ ἐμεσίτευσεν ὅρκῳ,

text_en: That by two immutable things in which it is impossible for God to lie , we may have the strongest comfort, we who have fled for refuge to hold fast the hope set before us.
text_la: ut per duas res immobiles, quibus impossibile est mentiri Deum, fortissimum solatium habeamus, qui confugimus ad tenendam propositam spem,
text_pt: Para que por duas coisas imutáveis, nas quais é impossível que Deus minta, tenhamos a firme consolação, nós, os que pomos o nosso refúgio em reter a esperança proposta;
text_el: ἵνα διὰ δύο πραγμάτων ἀμεταθέτων, ἐν οἷς ἀδύνατον ψεύσασθαι θεόν, ἰσχυρὰν παράκλησιν ἔχωμεν οἱ καταφυγόντες κρατῆσαι τῆς προκειμένης ἐλπίδος:

text_en: Which we have as an anchor of the soul , sure and firm, and which enters in even within the veil:
text_la: quam sicut anchoram habemus animæ tutam ac firmam, et incedentem usque ad interiora velaminis,
text_pt: A qual temos como âncora da alma, segura e firme, e que penetra até ao interior do véu,
text_el: ἣν ὡς ἄγκυραν ἔχομεν τῆς ψυχῆς, ἀσφαλῆ τε καὶ βεβαίαν καὶ εἰσερχομένην εἰς τὸ ἐσώτερον τοῦ καταπετάσματος,

text_en: Where the forerunner Jesus is entered for us, made a high priest for ever according to the order of Melchisedech .
text_la: ubi præcursor pro nobis introivit Jesus, secundum ordinem Melchisedech pontifex factus in æternum.
text_pt: Onde Jesus, nosso precursor, entrou por nós, feito eternamente sumo sacerdote, segundo a ordem de Melquisedeque.
text_el: ὅπου πρόδρομος ὑπὲρ ἡμῶν εἰσῆλθεν Ἰησοῦς, κατὰ τὴν τάξιν Μελχισέδεκ ἀρχιερεὺς γενόμενος εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα.

text_en: For this Melchisedech was king of Salem , priest of the most high God , who met Abraham returning from the slaughter of the kings and blessed him:
text_la: Hic enim Melchisedech, rex Salem, sacerdos Dei summi, qui obviavit Abrahæ regresso a cæde regum, et benedixit ei:
text_pt: Porque este Melquisedeque, que era rei de Salém, sacerdote do Deus Altíssimo, e que saiu ao encontro de Abraão quando ele regressava da matança dos reis, e o abençoou;
text_el: Οὗτος γὰρ ὁ Μελχισέδεκ, βασιλεὺς Σαλήμ, ἱερεὺς τοῦ θεοῦ τοῦ ὑψίστου, ὁ συναντήσας Ἀβραὰμ ὑποστρέφοντι ἀπὸ τῆς κοπῆς τῶν βασιλέων καὶ εὐλογήσας αὐτόν,

text_en: To whom also Abraham divided the tithes of all: who first indeed by interpretation is king of justice : and then also king of Salem , that is, king of peace:
text_la: cui et decimas omnium divisit Abraham : primum quidem qui interpretatur rex justitiæ : deinde autem et rex Salem, quod est, rex pacis,
text_pt: A quem também Abraão deu o dízimo de tudo, e primeiramente é, por interpretação, rei de justiça, e depois também rei de Salém, que é rei de paz;
text_el: ᾧ καὶ δεκάτην ἀπὸ πάντων ἐμέρισεν Ἀβραάμ, πρῶτον μὲν ἑρμηνευόμενος βασιλεὺς δικαιοσύνης ἔπειτα δὲ καὶ βασιλεὺς Σαλήμ, ὅ ἐστιν βασιλεὺς εἰρήνης,

text_en: Without father, without mother, without genealogy , having neither beginning of days nor end of life , but likened unto the Son of God , continues a priest for ever.
text_la: sine patre, sine matre, sine genealogia, neque initium dierum, neque finem vitæ habens, assimilatus autem Filio Dei, manet sacerdos in perpetuum.
text_pt: Sem pai, sem mãe, sem genealogia, não tendo princípio de dias nem fim de vida, mas sendo feito semelhante ao Filho de Deus, permanece sacerdote para sempre.
text_el: ἀπάτωρ, ἀμήτωρ, ἀγενεαλόγητος, μήτε ἀρχὴν ἡμερῶν μήτε ζωῆς τέλος ἔχων, ἀφωμοιωμένος δὲ τῷ υἱῷ τοῦ θεοῦ, μένει ἱερεὺς εἰς τὸ διηνεκές.

text_en: Now consider how great this man is, to whom also Abraham the patriarch gave tithes out of the principal things.
text_la: Intuemini autem quantus sit hic, cui et decimas dedit de præcipuis Abraham patriarcha.
text_pt: Considerai, pois, quão grande era este, a quem até o patriarca Abraão deu os dízimos dos despojos.
text_el: Θεωρεῖτε δὲ πηλίκος οὗτος ᾧ δεκάτην Ἀβραὰμ ἔδωκεν ἐκ τῶν ἀκροθινίων ὁ πατριάρχης.

text_en: And indeed they that are of the sons of Levi , who receive the priesthood , have a commandment to take tithes of the people according to the law , that is to say, of their brethren: though they themselves also came out of the loins of Abraham .
text_la: Et quidem de filiis Levi sacerdotium accipientes, mandatum habent decimas sumere a populo secundum legem, id est, a fratribus suis : quamquam et ipsi exierint de lumbis Abrahæ.
text_pt: E os que dentre os filhos de Levi recebem o sacerdócio têm ordem, segundo a lei, de tomar o dízimo do povo, isto é, de seus irmãos, ainda que tenham saído dos lombos de Abraão.
text_el: καὶ οἱ μὲν ἐκ τῶν υἱῶν Λευὶ τὴν ἱερατείαν λαμβάνοντες ἐντολὴν ἔχουσιν ἀποδεκατοῦν τὸν λαὸν κατὰ τὸν νόμον, τοῦτ' ἔστιν τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς αὐτῶν, καίπερ ἐξεληλυθότας ἐκ τῆς ὀσφύος Ἀβραάμ:

text_en: But he, whose pedigree is not numbered among them, received tithes of Abraham and blessed him that had the promises .
text_la: Cujus autem generatio non annumeratur in eis, decimas sumpsit ab Abraham, et hunc, qui habebat repromissiones, benedixit.
text_pt: Mas aquele, cuja genealogia não é contada entre eles, tomou dízimos de Abraão, e abençoou o que tinha as promessas.
text_el: ὁ δὲ μὴ γενεαλογούμενος ἐξ αὐτῶν δεδεκάτωκεν Ἀβραάμ, καὶ τὸν ἔχοντα τὰς ἐπαγγελίας εὐλόγηκεν.

text_en: And without all contradiction, that which is less is blessed by the better.
text_la: Sine ulla autem contradictione, quod minus est, a meliore benedicitur.
text_pt: Ora, sem contradição alguma, o menor é abençoado pelo maior.
text_el: χωρὶς δὲ πάσης ἀντιλογίας τὸ ἔλαττον ὑπὸ τοῦ κρείττονος εὐλογεῖται.

text_en: And here indeed, men that die receive tithes : but there, he has witness that he lives.
text_la: Et hic quidem, decimas morientes homines accipiunt : ibi autem contestatur, quia vivit.
text_pt: E aqui certamente tomam dízimos homens que morrem; ali, porém, aquele de quem se testifica que vive.
text_el: καὶ ὧδε μὲν δεκάτας ἀποθνῄσκοντες ἄνθρωποι λαμβάνουσιν, ἐκεῖ δὲ μαρτυρούμενος ὅτι ζῇ.

text_en: And (as it may be said) even Levi who received tithes paid tithes in Abraham :
text_la: Et (ut ita dictum sit) per Abraham, et Levi, qui decimas accepit, decimatus est:
text_pt: E, por assim dizer, por meio de Abraão, até Levi, que recebe dízimos, pagou dízimos.
text_el: καὶ ὡς ἔπος εἰπεῖν, δι' Ἀβραὰμ καὶ Λευὶς ὁ δεκάτας λαμβάνων δεδεκάτωται:

text_en: For he was yet in the loins of his father when Melchisedech met him.
text_la: adhuc enim in lumbis patris erat, quando obviavit ei Melchisedech.
text_pt: Porque ainda ele estava nos lombos de seu pai quando Melquisedeque lhe saiu ao encontro.
text_el: ἔτι γὰρ ἐν τῇ ὀσφύϊ τοῦ πατρὸς ἦν ὅτε συνήντησεν αὐτῷ Μελχισέδεκ.

text_en: If then perfection was by the Levitical priesthood (for under it the people received the law ), what further need was there that another priest should rise according to the order of Melchisedech : and not be called according to the order of Aaron ?
text_la: Si ergo consummatio per sacerdotium Leviticum erat (populus enim sub ipso legem accepit) quid adhuc necessarium fuit secundum ordinem Melchisedech, alium surgere sacerdotem, et non secundum ordinem Aaron dici?
text_pt: De sorte que, se a perfeição fosse pelo sacerdócio levítico (porque sob ele o povo recebeu a lei), que necessidade havia logo de que outro sacerdote se levantasse, segundo a ordem de Melquisedeque, e não fosse chamado segundo a ordem de Arão?
text_el: Εἰ μὲν οὖν τελείωσις διὰ τῆς Λευιτικῆς ἱερωσύνης ἦν, ὁ λαὸς γὰρ ἐπ' αὐτῆς νενομοθέτηται, τίς ἔτι χρεία κατὰ τὴν τάξιν Μελχισέδεκ ἕτερον ἀνίστασθαι ἱερέα καὶ οὐ κατὰ τὴν τάξιν Ἀαρὼν λέγεσθαι;

text_en: For the priesthood being translated, it is necessary that a translation also be made of the law ,
text_la: Translato enim sacerdotio, necesse est ut et legis translatio fiat.
text_pt: Porque, mudando-se o sacerdócio, necessariamente se faz também mudança da lei.
text_el: μετατιθεμένης γὰρ τῆς ἱερωσύνης ἐξ ἀνάγκης καὶ νόμου μετάθεσις γίνεται.

text_en: for he of whom these things are spoken is of another tribe , of which no one attended on the altar .
text_la: In quo enim hæc dicuntur, de alia tribu est, de qua nullus altari præsto fuit.
text_pt: Porque aquele de quem estas coisas se dizem pertence a outra tribo, da qual ninguém serviu ao altar,
text_el: ἐφ' ὃν γὰρ λέγεται ταῦτα φυλῆς ἑτέρας μετέσχηκεν, ἀφ' ἧς οὐδεὶς προσέσχηκεν τῷ θυσιαστηρίῳ:

text_en: For it is evident that our Lord sprung out of Juda : in which tribe Moses spoke nothing concerning priests .
text_la: Manifestum est enim quod ex Juda ortus sit Dominus noster : in qua tribu nihil de sacerdotibus Moyses locutus est.
text_pt: Visto ser manifesto que nosso Senhor procedeu de Judá, e concernente a essa tribo nunca Moisés falou de sacerdócio.
text_el: πρόδηλον γὰρ ὅτι ἐξ Ἰούδα ἀνατέταλκεν ὁ κύριος ἡμῶν, εἰς ἣν φυλὴν περὶ ἱερέων οὐδὲν Μωϋσῆς ἐλάλησεν.

text_en: And it is yet far more evident: if according to the similitude of Melchisedech there arises another priest ,
text_la: Et amplius adhuc manifestum est : si secundum similitudinem Melchisedech exsurgat alius sacerdos,
text_pt: E muito mais manifesto é ainda, se à semelhança de Melquisedeque se levantar outro sacerdote,
text_el: καὶ περισσότερον ἔτι κατάδηλόν ἐστιν, εἰ κατὰ τὴν ὁμοιότητα Μελχισέδεκ ἀνίσταται ἱερεὺς ἕτερος,

text_en: who is made, not according to the law of a carnal commandment, but according to the power of an indissoluble life.
text_la: qui non secundum legem mandati carnalis factus est, sed secundum virtutem vitæ insolubilis.
text_pt: Que não foi feito segundo a lei do mandamento carnal, mas segundo a virtude da vida incorruptível.
text_el: ὃς οὐ κατὰ νόμον ἐντολῆς σαρκίνης γέγονεν ἀλλὰ κατὰ δύναμιν ζωῆς ἀκαταλύτου,

text_en: For he testifies: You are a priest for ever according to the order of Melchisedech .
text_la: Contestatur enim : Quoniam tu es sacerdos in æternum, secundum ordinem Melchisedech.
text_pt: Porque ele assim testifica: Tu és sacerdote eternamente, Segundo a ordem de Melquisedeque.
text_el: μαρτυρεῖται γὰρ ὅτι σὺ ἱερεὺς εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα κατὰ τὴν τάξιν Μελχισέδεκ.

text_en: There is indeed a setting aside of the former commandment, because of the weakness and unprofitableness thereof:
text_la: Reprobatio quidem fit præcedentis mandati, propter infirmitatem ejus, et inutilitatem:
text_pt: Porque o precedente mandamento é abrogado por causa da sua fraqueza e inutilidade
text_el: Ἀθέτησις μὲν γὰρ γίνεται προαγούσης ἐντολῆς διὰ τὸ αὐτῆς ἀσθενὲς καὶ ἀνωφελές,

text_en: For the law brought nothing to perfection : but a bringing in of a better hope , by which we draw near to God .
text_la: nihil enim ad perfectum adduxit lex : introductio vero melioris spei, per quam proximamus ad Deum.
text_pt: (Pois a lei nenhuma coisa aperfeiçoou) e desta sorte é introduzida uma melhor esperança, pela qual chegamos a Deus.
text_el: οὐδὲν γὰρ ἐτελείωσεν ὁ νόμος, ἐπεισαγωγὴ δὲ κρείττονος ἐλπίδος, δι' ἧς ἐγγίζομεν τῷ θεῷ.

text_en: And inasmuch as it is not without an oath (for the others indeed were made priests without an oath :
text_la: Et quantum est non sine jurejurando (alii quidem sine jurejurando sacerdotes facti sunt,
text_pt: E visto como não é sem prestar juramento (porque certamente aqueles, sem juramento, foram feitos sacerdotes,
text_el: καὶ καθ' ὅσον οὐ χωρὶς ὁρκωμοσίας, οἱ μὲν γὰρ χωρὶς ὁρκωμοσίας εἰσὶν ἱερεῖς γεγονότες,

text_en: But this with an oath , by him that said unto him: The Lord has sworn and he will not repent: You are a priest for ever).
text_la: hic autem cum jurejurando per eum, qui dixit ad illum : Juravit Dominus, et non pœnitebit eum : tu es sacerdos in æternum):
text_pt: Mas este com juramento por aquele que lhe disse: Jurou o Senhor, e não se arrependerá; Tu és sacerdote eternamente, Segundo a ordem de Melquisedeque,
text_el: ὁ δὲ μετὰ ὁρκωμοσίας διὰ τοῦ λέγοντος πρὸς αὐτόν, ὤμοσεν κύριος, καὶ οὐ μεταμεληθήσεται, σὺ ἱερεὺς εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα,

text_en: By so much is Jesus made a surety of a better testament.
text_la: in tantum melioris testamenti sponsor factus est Jesus.
text_pt: De tanto melhor aliança Jesus foi feito fiador.
text_el: κατὰ τοσοῦτο καὶ κρείττονος διαθήκης γέγονεν ἔγγυος Ἰησοῦς.

text_en: And the others indeed were made many priests , because by reason of death they were not suffered to continue:
text_la: Et alii quidem plures facti sunt sacerdotes, idcirco quod morte prohiberentur permanere:
text_pt: E, na verdade, aqueles foram feitos sacerdotes em grande número, porque pela morte foram impedidos de permanecer,
text_el: καὶ οἱ μὲν πλείονές εἰσιν γεγονότες ἱερεῖς διὰ τὸ θανάτῳ κωλύεσθαι παραμένειν:

text_en: But this, for that he continues for ever, has an everlasting priesthood :
text_la: hic autem eo quod maneat in æternum, sempiternum habet sacerdotium.
text_pt: Mas este, porque permanece eternamente, tem um sacerdócio perpétuo.
text_el: ὁ δὲ διὰ τὸ μένειν αὐτὸν εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα ἀπαράβατον ἔχει τὴν ἱερωσύνην:

text_en: Whereby he is able also to save for ever them that come to God by him; always living to make intercession for us.
text_la: Unde et salvare in perpetuum potest accedentes per semetipsum ad Deum : semper vivens ad interpellandum pro nobis.
text_pt: Portanto, pode também salvar perfeitamente os que por ele se chegam a Deus, vivendo sempre para interceder por eles.
text_el: ὅθεν καὶ σῴζειν εἰς τὸ παντελὲς δύναται τοὺς προσερχομένους δι' αὐτοῦ τῷ θεῷ, πάντοτε ζῶν εἰς τὸ ἐντυγχάνειν ὑπὲρ αὐτῶν.

text_en: For it was fitting that we should have such a high priest , holy , innocent, undefiled, separated from sinners, and made higher than the heavens :
text_la: Talis enim decebat ut nobis esset pontifex, sanctus, innocens, impollutus, segregatus a peccatoribus, et excelsior cælis factus:
text_pt: Porque nos convinha tal sumo sacerdote, santo, inocente, imaculado, separado dos pecadores, e feito mais sublime do que os céus;
text_el: Τοιοῦτος γὰρ ἡμῖν [καὶ] ἔπρεπεν ἀρχιερεύς, ὅσιος, ἄκακος, ἀμίαντος, κεχωρισμένος ἀπὸ τῶν ἁμαρτωλῶν, καὶ ὑψηλότερος τῶν οὐρανῶν γενόμενος,

text_en: Who needs not daily (as the other priests ) to offer sacrifices , first for his own sins , and then for the people's: for this he did once, in offering himself.
text_la: qui non habet necessitatem quotidie, quemadmodum sacerdotes, prius pro suis delictis hostias offerre, deinde pro populi : hoc enim fecit semel, seipsum offerendo.
text_pt: Que não necessitasse, como os sumos sacerdotes, de oferecer cada dia sacrifícios, primeiramente por seus próprios pecados, e depois pelos do povo; porque isto fez ele, uma vez, oferecendo-se a si mesmo.
text_el: ὃς οὐκ ἔχει καθ' ἡμέραν ἀνάγκην, ὥσπερ οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς, πρότερον ὑπὲρ τῶν ἰδίων ἁμαρτιῶν θυσίας ἀναφέρειν, ἔπειτα τῶν τοῦ λαοῦ: τοῦτο γὰρ ἐποίησεν ἐφάπαξ ἑαυτὸν ἀνενέγκας.

text_en: For the law makes men priests , who have infirmity: but the word of the oath (which was since the law ) the Son who is perfected for evermore.
text_la: Lex enim homines constituit sacerdotes infirmitatem habentes : sermo autem jurisjurandi, qui post legem est, Filium in æternum perfectum.
text_pt: Porque a lei constitui sumos sacerdotes a homens fracos, mas a palavra do juramento, que veio depois da lei, constitui ao Filho, perfeito para sempre.
text_el: ὁ νόμος γὰρ ἀνθρώπους καθίστησιν ἀρχιερεῖς ἔχοντας ἀσθένειαν, ὁ λόγος δὲ τῆς ὁρκωμοσίας τῆς μετὰ τὸν νόμον υἱὸν εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τετελειωμένον.

text_en: Now of the things which we have spoken, this is the sum: We have such an high priest who is set on the right hand of the throne of majesty in the heavens ,
text_la: Capitulum autem super ea quæ dicuntur : Talem habemus pontificem, qui consedit in dextera sedis magnitudinis in cælis,
text_pt: Ora, a suma do que temos dito é que temos um sumo sacerdote tal, que está assentado nos céus à destra do trono da majestade,
text_el: Κεφάλαιον δὲ ἐπὶ τοῖς λεγομένοις, τοιοῦτον ἔχομεν ἀρχιερέα, ὃς ἐκάθισεν ἐν δεξιᾷ τοῦ θρόνου τῆς μεγαλωσύνης ἐν τοῖς οὐρανοῖς,

text_en: a minister of the holies and of the true tabernacle, which the Lord has pitched, and not man .
text_la: sanctorum minister, et tabernaculi veri, quod fixit Dominus, et non homo.
text_pt: Ministro do santuário, e do verdadeiro tabernáculo, o qual o Senhor fundou, e não o homem.
text_el: τῶν ἁγίων λειτουργὸς καὶ τῆς σκηνῆς τῆς ἀληθινῆς, ἣν ἔπηξεν ὁ κύριος, οὐκ ἄνθρωπος.

text_en: For every high priest is appointed to offer gifts and sacrifices : wherefore it is necessary that he also should have some thing to offer .
text_la: Omnis enim pontifex ad offerendum munera, et hostias constituitur : unde necesse est et hunc habere aliquid, quod offerat.
text_pt: Porque todo o sumo sacerdote é constituído para oferecer dons e sacrifícios; por isso era necessário que este também tivesse alguma coisa que oferecer.
text_el: πᾶς γὰρ ἀρχιερεὺς εἰς τὸ προσφέρειν δῶρά τε καὶ θυσίας καθίσταται: ὅθεν ἀναγκαῖον ἔχειν τι καὶ τοῦτον ὃ προσενέγκῃ.

text_en: If then he were on earth, he would not be a priest : seeing that there would be others to offer gifts according to the law .
text_la: Si ergo esset super terram, nec esset sacerdos : cum essent qui offerent secundum legem munera,
text_pt: Ora, se ele estivesse na terra, nem tão pouco sacerdote seria, havendo ainda sacerdotes que oferecem dons segundo a lei,
text_el: εἰ μὲν οὖν ἦν ἐπὶ γῆς, οὐδ' ἂν ἦν ἱερεύς, ὄντων τῶν προσφερόντων κατὰ νόμον τὰ δῶρα:

text_en: Who serve unto the example and shadow of heavenly things. As it was answered to Moses , when he was to finish the tabernacle : See (says he) that you make all things according to the pattern which was shown you on the mount.
text_la: qui exemplari, et umbræ deserviunt cælestium. Sicut responsum est Moysi, cum consummaret tabernaculum : Vide (inquit) omnia facito secundum exemplar, quod tibi ostensum est in monte.
text_pt: Os quais servem de exemplo e sombra das coisas celestiais, como Moisés divinamente foi avisado, estando já para acabar o tabernáculo; porque foi dito: Olha, faze tudo conforme o modelo que no monte se te mostrou.
text_el: οἵτινες ὑποδείγματι καὶ σκιᾷ λατρεύουσιν τῶν ἐπουρανίων, καθὼς κεχρημάτισται Μωϋσῆς μέλλων ἐπιτελεῖν τὴν σκηνήν: ὅρα γάρ φησίν ποιήσεις πάντα κατὰ τὸν τύπον τὸν δειχθέντα σοι ἐν τῷ ὄρει:

text_en: But now he has obtained a better ministry , by how much also he is a mediator of a better testament which is established on better promises .
text_la: Nunc autem melius sortitus est ministerium, quanto et melioris testamenti mediator est, quod in melioribus repromissionibus sancitum est.
text_pt: Mas agora alcançou ele ministério tanto mais excelente, quanto é mediador de uma melhor aliança que está confirmada em melhores promessas.
text_el: νῦν δὲ διαφορωτέρας τέτυχεν λειτουργίας, ὅσῳ καὶ κρείττονός ἐστιν διαθήκης μεσίτης, ἥτις ἐπὶ κρείττοσιν ἐπαγγελίαις νενομοθέτηται.

text_en: For if that former had been faultless, there should not indeed a place have been sought for a second.
text_la: Nam si illud prius culpa vacasset, non utique secundi locus inquireretur.
text_pt: Porque, se aquela primeira fora irrepreensível, nunca se teria buscado lugar para a segunda.
text_el: Εἰ γὰρ ἡ πρώτη ἐκείνη ἦν ἄμεμπτος, οὐκ ἂν δευτέρας ἐζητεῖτο τόπος:

text_en: For, finding fault with them, he says: Behold the days shall come, says the Lord : and I will perfect, unto the house of Israel and unto the house of Juda , a new testament:
text_la: Vituperans enim eos dicit : Ecce dies venient, dicit Dominus : et consummabo super domum Israël, et super domum Juda, testamentum novum,
text_pt: Porque, repreendendo-os, lhes diz: Eis que virão dias, diz o Senhor, Em que com a casa de Israel e com a casa de Judá estabelecerei uma nova aliança,
text_el: μεμφόμενος γὰρ αὐτοὺς λέγει, ἰδοὺ ἡμέραι ἔρχονται, λέγει κύριος, καὶ συντελέσω ἐπὶ τὸν οἶκον Ἰσραὴλ καὶ ἐπὶ τὸν οἶκον Ἰούδα διαθήκην καινήν,

text_en: Not according to the testament which I made to their fathers, on the day when I took them by the hand to lead them out of the land of Egypt : because they continued not in my testament: and I regarded them not, says the Lord .
text_la: non secundum testamentum quod feci patribus eorum in die qua apprehendi manum eorum ut educerem illos de terra Ægypti : quoniam ipsi non permanserunt in testamento meo : et ego neglexi eos, dicit Dominus.
text_pt: Não segundo a aliança que fiz com seus pais No dia em que os tomei pela mão, para os tirar da terra do Egito;Como não permaneceram naquela minha aliança,Eu para eles não atentei, diz o Senhor.
text_el: οὐ κατὰ τὴν διαθήκην ἣν ἐποίησα τοῖς πατράσιν αὐτῶν ἐν ἡμέρᾳ ἐπιλαβομένου μου τῆς χειρὸς αὐτῶν ἐξαγαγεῖν αὐτοὺς ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου, ὅτι αὐτοὶ οὐκ ἐνέμειναν ἐν τῇ διαθήκῃ μου, κἀγὼ ἠμέλησα αὐτῶν, λέγει κύριος.

text_en: For this is the testament which I will make to the house of Israel after those days, says the Lord : I will give my laws into their mind : and in their heart will I write them. And I will be their God : and they shall be my people.
text_la: Quia hoc est testamentum quod disponam domui Israël post dies illos, dicit Dominus : dando leges meas in mentem eorum, et in corde eorum superscribam eas : et ero eis in Deum, et ipsi erunt mihi in populum:
text_pt: Porque esta é a aliança que depois daqueles diasFarei com a casa de Israel, diz o Senhor; Porei as minhas leis no seu entendimento, E em seu coração as escreverei; E eu lhes serei por Deus, E eles me serão por povo;
text_el: ὅτι αὕτη ἡ διαθήκη ἣν διαθήσομαι τῷ οἴκῳ Ἰσραὴλ μετὰ τὰς ἡμέρας ἐκείνας, λέγει κύριος, διδοὺς νόμους μου εἰς τὴν διάνοιαν αὐτῶν, καὶ ἐπὶ καρδίας αὐτῶν ἐπιγράψω αὐτούς, καὶ ἔσομαι αὐτοῖς εἰς θεὸν καὶ αὐτοὶ ἔσονταί μοι εἰς λαόν.

text_en: And they shall not teach every man his neighbour and every man his brother, saying: Know the Lord . For all shall know me, from the least to the greatest of them.
text_la: et non docebit unusquisque proximum suum, et unusquisque fratrem suum, dicens : Cognosce Dominum : quoniam omnes scient me a minore usque ad majorem eorum:
text_pt: E não ensinará cada um a seu próximo, Nem cada um ao seu irmão, dizendo: Conhece o Senhor; Porque todos me conhecerão, Desde o menor deles até ao maior.
text_el: καὶ οὐ μὴ διδάξωσιν ἕκαστος τὸν πολίτην αὐτοῦ καὶ ἕκαστος τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ, λέγων, γνῶθι τὸν κύριον, ὅτι πάντες εἰδήσουσίν με ἀπὸ μικροῦ ἕως μεγάλου αὐτῶν.

text_en: Because I will be merciful to their iniquities : and their sins I will remember no more.
text_la: quia propitius ero iniquitatibus eorum, et peccatorum eorum jam non memorabor.
text_pt: Porque serei misericordioso para com suas iniqüidades, E de seus pecados e de suas prevaricações não me lembrarei mais.
text_el: ὅτι ἵλεως ἔσομαι ταῖς ἀδικίαις αὐτῶν, καὶ τῶν ἁμαρτιῶν αὐτῶν οὐ μὴ μνησθῶ ἔτι.

text_en: Now in saying a new, he has made the former old. And that which decays and grows old is near its end.
text_la: Dicendo autem novum : veteravit prius. Quod autem antiquatur, et senescit, prope interitum est.
text_pt: Dizendo Nova aliança, envelheceu a primeira. Ora, o que foi tornado velho, e se envelhece, perto está de acabar.
text_el: ἐν τῷ λέγειν καινὴν πεπαλαίωκεν τὴν πρώτην: τὸ δὲ παλαιούμενον καὶ γηράσκον ἐγγὺς ἀφανισμοῦ.

text_en: The former indeed had also justifications of divine service and a sanctuary.
text_la: Habuit quidem et prius justificationes culturæ, et Sanctum sæculare.
text_pt: Ora, também a primeira tinha ordenanças de culto divino, e um santuário terrestre.
text_el: Εἶχε μὲν οὖν καὶ ἡ πρώτη δικαιώματα λατρείας τό τε ἅγιον κοσμικόν.

text_en: For there was a tabernacle made the first, wherein were the candlesticks and the table and the setting forth of loaves , which is called the Holy.
text_la: Tabernaculum enim factum est primum, in quo erant candelabra, et mensa, et propositio panum, quæ dicitur Sancta.
text_pt: Porque um tabernáculo estava preparado, o primeiro, em que havia o candeeiro, e a mesa, e os pães da proposição; ao que se chama o santuário.
text_el: σκηνὴ γὰρ κατεσκευάσθη ἡ πρώτη ἐν ᾗ ἥ τε λυχνία καὶ ἡ τράπεζα καὶ ἡ πρόθεσις τῶν ἄρτων, ἥτις λέγεται ἅγια:

text_en: And after the second veil, the tabernacle which is called the Holy of Holies:
text_la: Post velamentum autem secundum, tabernaculum, quod dicitur Sancta sanctorum:
text_pt: Mas depois do segundo véu estava o tabernáculo que se chama o santo dos santos,
text_el: μετὰ δὲ τὸ δεύτερον καταπέτασμα σκηνὴ ἡ λεγομένη ἅγια ἁγίων,

text_en: Having a golden censer and the ark of the testament covered about on every part with gold, in which was a golden pot that had manna and the rod of Aaron that had blossomed and the tables of the testament .
text_la: aureum habens thuribulum, et arcam testamenti circumtectam ex omni parte auro, in qua urna aurea habens manna, et virga Aaron, quæ fronduerat, et tabulæ testamenti,
text_pt: Que tinha o incensário de ouro, e a arca da aliança, coberta de ouro toda em redor; em que estava um vaso de ouro, que continha o maná, e a vara de Arão, que tinha florescido, e as tábuas da aliança;
text_el: χρυσοῦν ἔχουσα θυμιατήριον καὶ τὴν κιβωτὸν τῆς διαθήκης περικεκαλυμμένην πάντοθεν χρυσίῳ, ἐν ᾗ στάμνος χρυσῆ ἔχουσα τὸ μάννα καὶ ἡ ῥάβδος Ἀαρὼν ἡ βλαστήσασα καὶ αἱ πλάκες τῆς διαθήκης,

text_en: And over it were the cherubims of glory overshadowing the propitiatory: of which it is not needful to speak now particularly.
text_la: superque eam erant cherubim gloriæ obumbrantia propitiatorium : de quibus non est modo dicendum per singula.
text_pt: E sobre a arca os querubins da glória, que faziam sombra no propiciatório; das quais coisas não falaremos agora particularmente.
text_el: ὑπεράνω δὲ αὐτῆς Χερουβὶν δόξης κατασκιάζοντα τὸ ἱλαστήριον: περὶ ὧν οὐκ ἔστιν νῦν λέγειν κατὰ μέρος.

text_en: Now these things being thus ordered, into the first tabernacle , the priests indeed always entered, accomplishing the offices of sacrifices .
text_la: His vero ita compositis, in priori quidem tabernaculo semper introibant sacerdotes, sacrificiorum officia consummantes:
text_pt: Ora, estando estas coisas assim preparadas, a todo o tempo entravam os sacerdotes no primeiro tabernáculo, cumprindo os serviços;
text_el: Τούτων δὲ οὕτως κατεσκευασμένων, εἰς μὲν τὴν πρώτην σκηνὴν διὰ παντὸς εἰσίασιν οἱ ἱερεῖς τὰς λατρείας ἐπιτελοῦντες,

text_en: But into the second, the high priest alone, once a year: not without blood, which he offers for his own and the people's ignorance :
text_la: in secundo autem semel in anno solus pontifex non sine sanguine, quem offert pro sua et populi ignorantia:
text_pt: Mas, no segundo, só o sumo sacerdote, uma vez no ano, não sem sangue, que oferecia por si mesmo e pelas culpas do povo;
text_el: εἰς δὲ τὴν δευτέραν ἅπαξ τοῦ ἐνιαυτοῦ μόνος ὁ ἀρχιερεύς, οὐ χωρὶς αἵματος, ὃ προσφέρει ὑπὲρ ἑαυτοῦ καὶ τῶν τοῦ λαοῦ ἀγνοημάτων,

text_en: The Holy Ghost signifying this: That the way into the Holies was not yet made manifest, whilst the former tabernacle was yet standing.
text_la: hoc significante Spiritu Sancto, nondum propalatam esse sanctorum viam, adhuc priore tabernaculo habente statum:
text_pt: Dando nisto a entender o Espírito Santo que ainda o caminho do santuário não estava descoberto enquanto se conservava em pé o primeiro tabernáculo,
text_el: τοῦτο δηλοῦντος τοῦ πνεύματος τοῦ ἁγίου, μήπω πεφανερῶσθαι τὴν τῶν ἁγίων ὁδὸν ἔτι τῆς πρώτης σκηνῆς ἐχούσης στάσιν,

text_en: Which is a parable of the time present: according to which gifts and sacrifices are offered , which cannot, as to the conscience , make him perfect that serves, only in meats and in drinks,
text_la: quæ parabola est temporis instantis : juxta quam munera, et hostiæ offeruntur, quæ non possunt juxta conscientiam perfectum facere servientem, solummodo in cibis, et in potibus,
text_pt: Que é uma alegoria para o tempo presente, em que se oferecem dons e sacrifícios que, quanto à consciência, não podem aperfeiçoar aquele que faz o serviço;
text_el: ἥτις παραβολὴ εἰς τὸν καιρὸν τὸν ἐνεστηκότα, καθ' ἣν δῶρά τε καὶ θυσίαι προσφέρονται μὴ δυνάμεναι κατὰ συνείδησιν τελειῶσαι τὸν λατρεύοντα,

text_en: and divers washings and justices of the flesh laid on them until the time of correction.
text_la: et variis baptismatibus, et justitiis carnis usque ad tempus correctionis impositis.
text_pt: Consistindo somente em comidas, e bebidas, e várias abluções e justificações da carne, impostas até ao tempo da correção.
text_el: μόνον ἐπὶ βρώμασιν καὶ πόμασιν καὶ διαφόροις βαπτισμοῖς, δικαιώματα σαρκὸς μέχρι καιροῦ διορθώσεως ἐπικείμενα.

text_en: But Christ , being come an high priest of the good things to come, by a greater and more perfect tabernacle, not made with hand, that is, not of this creation :
text_la: Christus autem assistens pontifex futurorum bonorum, per amplius et perfectius tabernaculum, non manufactum, id est, non hujus creationis:
text_pt: Mas, vindo Cristo, o sumo sacerdote dos bens futuros, por um maior e mais perfeito tabernáculo, não feito por mãos, isto é, não desta criação,
text_el: Χριστὸς δὲ παραγενόμενος ἀρχιερεὺς τῶν γενομένων ἀγαθῶν διὰ τῆς μείζονος καὶ τελειοτέρας σκηνῆς οὐ χειροποιήτου, τοῦτ' ἔστιν οὐ ταύτης τῆς κτίσεως,

text_en: Neither by the blood of goats or of calves, but by his own blood, entered once into the Holies, having obtained eternal redemption .
text_la: neque per sanguinem hircorum aut vitulorum, sed per proprium sanguinem introivit semel in Sancta, æterna redemptione inventa.
text_pt: Nem por sangue de bodes e bezerros, mas por seu próprio sangue, entrou uma vez no santuário, havendo efetuado uma eterna redenção.
text_el: οὐδὲ δι' αἵματος τράγων καὶ μόσχων διὰ δὲ τοῦ ἰδίου αἵματος, εἰσῆλθεν ἐφάπαξ εἰς τὰ ἅγια, αἰωνίαν λύτρωσιν εὑράμενος.

text_en: For if the blood of goats and of oxen, and the ashes of an heifer, being sprinkled, sanctify such as are defiled, to the cleansing of the flesh:
text_la: Si enim sanguis hircorum et taurorum, et cinis vitulæ aspersus inquinatos sanctificat ad emundationem carnis:
text_pt: Porque, se o sangue dos touros e bodes, e a cinza de uma novilha esparzida sobre os imundos, os santifica, quanto à purificação da carne,
text_el: εἰ γὰρ τὸ αἷμα τράγων καὶ ταύρων καὶ σποδὸς δαμάλεως ῥαντίζουσα τοὺς κεκοινωμένους ἁγιάζει πρὸς τὴν τῆς σαρκὸς καθαρότητα,

text_en: How much more shall the blood of Christ , who by the Holy Ghost offered himself unspotted unto God , cleanse our conscience from dead works , to serve the living God ?
text_la: quanto magis sanguis Christi, qui per Spiritum Sanctum semetipsum obtulit immaculatum Deo, emundabit conscientiam nostram ab operibus mortuis, ad serviendum Deo viventi?
text_pt: Quanto mais o sangue de Cristo, que pelo Espírito eterno se ofereceu a si mesmo imaculado a Deus, purificará as vossas consciências das obras mortas, para servirdes ao Deus vivo?
text_el: πόσῳ μᾶλλον τὸ αἷμα τοῦ Χριστοῦ, ὃς διὰ πνεύματος αἰωνίου ἑαυτὸν προσήνεγκεν ἄμωμον τῷ θεῷ, καθαριεῖ τὴν συνείδησιν ἡμῶν ἀπὸ νεκρῶν ἔργων εἰς τὸ λατρεύειν θεῷ ζῶντι.

text_en: And therefore he is the mediator of the new testament: that by means of his death for the redemption of those transgressions which were under the former testament, they that are called may receive the promise of eternal inheritance.
text_la: Et ideo novi testamenti mediator est : ut morte intercedente, in redemptionem earum prævaricationum, quæ erant sub priori testamento, repromissionem accipiant qui vocati sunt æternæ hæreditatis.
text_pt: E por isso é Mediador de um novo testamento, para que, intervindo a morte para remissão das transgressões que havia debaixo do primeiro testamento, os chamados recebam a promessa da herança eterna.
text_el: Καὶ διὰ τοῦτο διαθήκης καινῆς μεσίτης ἐστίν, ὅπως θανάτου γενομένου εἰς ἀπολύτρωσιν τῶν ἐπὶ τῇ πρώτῃ διαθήκῃ παραβάσεων τὴν ἐπαγγελίαν λάβωσιν οἱ κεκλημένοι τῆς αἰωνίου κληρονομίας.

text_en: For where there is a testament the death of the testator must of necessity come in.
text_la: Ubi enim testamentum est, mors necesse est intercedat testatoris.
text_pt: Porque onde há testamento, é necessário que intervenha a morte do testador.
text_el: ὅπου γὰρ διαθήκη, θάνατον ἀνάγκη φέρεσθαι τοῦ διαθεμένου:

text_en: For a testament is of force after men are dead: otherwise it is as yet of no strength, whilst the testator lives.
text_la: Testamentum enim in mortuis confirmatum est : alioquin nondum valet, dum vivit qui testatus est.
text_pt: Porque um testamento tem força onde houve morte; ou terá ele algum valor enquanto o testador vive?
