text_el: διαθήκη γὰρ ἐπὶ νεκροῖς βεβαία, ἐπεὶ μὴ τότε μήποτε ἰσχύει ὅτε ζῇ ὁ διαθέμενος.

text_en: Whereupon neither was the first indeed dedicated without blood.
text_la: Unde nec primum quidem sine sanguine dedicatum est.
text_pt: Por isso também o primeiro não foi consagrado sem sangue;
text_el: ὅθεν οὐδὲ' ἡ πρώτη χωρὶς αἵματος ἐγκεκαίνισται:

text_en: For when every commandment of the law had been read by Moses to all the people, he took the blood of calves and goats, with water, and scarlet wool and hyssop , and sprinkled both the book itself and all the people.
text_la: Lecto enim omni mandato legis a Moyse universo populo, accipiens sanguinem vitulorum et hircorum cum aqua, et lana coccinea, et hyssopo, ipsum quoque librum, et omnem populum aspersit,
text_pt: Porque, havendo Moisés anunciado a todo o povo todos os mandamentos segundo a lei, tomou o sangue dos bezerros e dos bodes, com água, lã purpúrea e hissopo, e aspergiu tanto o mesmo livro como todo o povo,
text_el: λαληθείσης γὰρ πάσης ἐντολῆς κατὰ τὸν νόμον ὑπὸ Μωϋσέως παντὶ τῷ λαῷ, λαβὼν τὸ αἷμα τῶν μόσχων καὶ τῶν τράγων μετὰ ὕδατος καὶ ἐρίου κοκκίνου καὶ ὑσσώπου αὐτό τε τὸ βιβλίον καὶ πάντα τὸν λαὸν ἐράντισεν,

text_en: Saying: This is the blood of the testament which God has enjoined unto you.
text_la: dicens : Hic sanguis testamenti, quod mandavit ad vos Deus.
text_pt: Dizendo: Este é o sangue do testamento que Deus vos tem mandado.
text_el: λέγων, τοῦτο τὸ αἷμα τῆς διαθήκης ἧς ἐνετείλατο πρὸς ὑμᾶς ὁ θεός:

text_en: The tabernacle also and all the vessels of the ministry , in like manner, he sprinkled with blood.
text_la: Etiam tabernaculum et omnia vasa ministerii sanguine similiter aspersit.
text_pt: E semelhantemente aspergiu com sangue o tabernáculo e todos os vasos do ministério.
text_el: καὶ τὴν σκηνὴν δὲ καὶ πάντα τὰ σκεύη τῆς λειτουργίας τῷ αἵματι ὁμοίως ἐράντισεν.

text_en: And almost all things, according to the law , are cleansed with blood: and without shedding of blood there is no remission.
text_la: Et omnia pene in sanguine secundum legem mundantur: et sine sanguinis effusione non fit remissio.
text_pt: E quase todas as coisas, segundo a lei, se purificam com sangue; e sem derramamento de sangue não há remissão.
text_el: καὶ σχεδὸν ἐν αἵματι πάντα καθαρίζεται κατὰ τὸν νόμον, καὶ χωρὶς αἱματεκχυσίας οὐ γίνεται ἄφεσις.

text_en: It is necessary therefore that the patterns of heavenly things should be cleansed with these: but the heavenly things themselves with better sacrifices than these.
text_la: Necesse est ergo exemplaria quidem cælestium his mundari : ipsa autem cælestia melioribus hostiis quam istis.
text_pt: De sorte que era bem necessário que as figuras das coisas que estão no céu assim se purificassem; mas as próprias coisas celestiais com sacrifícios melhores do que estes.
text_el: ἀνάγκη οὖν τὰ μὲν ὑποδείγματα τῶν ἐν τοῖς οὐρανοῖς τούτοις καθαρίζεσθαι, αὐτὰ δὲ τὰ ἐπουράνια κρείττοσιν θυσίαις παρὰ ταύτας.

text_en: For Jesus is not entered into the Holies made with hands, the patterns of the true : but into Heaven itself, that he may appear now in the presence of God for us.
text_la: Non enim in manufacta Sancta Jesus introivit exemplaria verorum : sed in ipsum cælum, ut appareat nunc vultui Dei pro nobis:
text_pt: Porque Cristo não entrou num santuário feito por mãos, figura do verdadeiro, porém no mesmo céu, para agora comparecer por nós perante a face de Deus;
text_el: οὐ γὰρ εἰς χειροποίητα εἰσῆλθεν ἅγια Χριστός, ἀντίτυπα τῶν ἀληθινῶν, ἀλλ' εἰς αὐτὸν τὸν οὐρανόν, νῦν ἐμφανισθῆναι τῷ προσώπῳ τοῦ θεοῦ ὑπὲρ ἡμῶν:

text_en: Nor yet that he should offer himself often, as the high priest enters into the Holies every year with the blood of others:
text_la: neque ut sæpe offerat semetipsum, quemadmodum pontifex intrat in Sancta per singulos annos in sanguine alieno:
text_pt: Nem também para a si mesmo se oferecer muitas vezes, como o sumo sacerdote cada ano entra no santuário com sangue alheio;
text_el: οὐδ' ἵνα πολλάκις προσφέρῃ ἑαυτόν, ὥσπερ ὁ ἀρχιερεὺς εἰσέρχεται εἰς τὰ ἅγια κατ' ἐνιαυτὸν ἐν αἵματι ἀλλοτρίῳ,

text_en: For then he ought to have suffered often from the beginning of the world. But now once, at the end of ages, he has appeared for the destruction of sin by the sacrifice of himself.
text_la: alioquin oportebat eum frequenter pati ab origine mundi : nunc autem semel in consummatione sæculorum, ad destitutionem peccati, per hostiam suam apparuit.
text_pt: De outra maneira, necessário lhe fora padecer muitas vezes desde a fundação do mundo. Mas agora na consumação dos séculos uma vez se manifestou, para aniquilar o pecado pelo sacrifício de si mesmo.
text_el: ἐπεὶ ἔδει αὐτὸν πολλάκις παθεῖν ἀπὸ καταβολῆς κόσμου: νυνὶ δὲ ἅπαξ ἐπὶ συντελείᾳ τῶν αἰώνων εἰς ἀθέτησιν τῆς ἁμαρτίας διὰ τῆς θυσίας αὐτοῦ πεφανέρωται.

text_en: And as it is appointed unto men once to die, and after this the judgment :
text_la: Et quemadmodum statutum est hominibus semel mori, post hoc autem judicium:
text_pt: E, como aos homens está ordenado morrerem uma vez, vindo depois disso o juízo,
text_el: καὶ καθ' ὅσον ἀπόκειται τοῖς ἀνθρώποις ἅπαξ ἀποθανεῖν, μετὰ δὲ τοῦτο κρίσις,

text_en: So also Christ was offered once to exhaust the sins of many. The second time he shall appear without sin to them that expect him unto salvation .
text_la: sic et Christus semel oblatus est ad multorum exhaurienda peccata : secundo sine peccato apparebit exspectantibus se, in salutem.
text_pt: Assim também Cristo, oferecendo-se uma vez para tirar os pecados de muitos, aparecerá segunda vez, sem pecado, aos que o esperam para salvação.
text_el: οὕτως καὶ ὁ Χριστός, ἅπαξ προσενεχθεὶς εἰς τὸ πολλῶν ἀνενεγκεῖν ἁμαρτίας, ἐκ δευτέρου χωρὶς ἁμαρτίας ὀφθήσεται τοῖς αὐτὸν ἀπεκδεχομένοις εἰς σωτηρίαν.

text_en: For the law , having a shadow of the good things to come, not the very image of the things, by the selfsame sacrifices which they offer continually every year, can never make the comers thereunto perfect .
text_la: Umbram enim habens lex futurorum bonorum, non ipsam imaginem rerum : per singulos annos, eisdem ipsis hostiis quas offerunt indesinenter, numquam potest accedentes perfectos facere:
text_pt: Porque tendo a lei a sombra dos bens futuros, e não a imagem exata das coisas, nunca, pelos mesmos sacrifícios que continuamente se oferecem cada ano, pode aperfeiçoar os que a eles se chegam.
text_el: Σκιὰν γὰρ ἔχων ὁ νόμος τῶν μελλόντων ἀγαθῶν, οὐκ αὐτὴν τὴν εἰκόνα τῶν πραγμάτων, κατ' ἐνιαυτὸν ταῖς αὐταῖς θυσίαις ἃς προσφέρουσιν εἰς τὸ διηνεκὲς οὐδέποτε δύνανται τοὺς προσερχομένους τελειῶσαι:

text_en: For then they would have ceased to be offered : because the worshippers once cleansed should have no conscience of sin any longer.
text_la: alioquin cessassent offerri : ideo quod nullam haberent ultra conscientiam peccati, cultores semel mundati:
text_pt: Doutra maneira, teriam deixado de se oferecer, porque, purificados uma vez os ministrantes, nunca mais teriam consciência de pecado.
text_el: ἐπεὶ οὐκ ἂν ἐπαύσαντο προσφερόμεναι, διὰ τὸ μηδεμίαν ἔχειν ἔτι συνείδησιν ἁμαρτιῶν τοὺς λατρεύοντας ἅπαξ κεκαθαρισμένους;

text_en: But in them there is made a commemoration of sins every year:
text_la: sed in ipsis commemoratio peccatorum per singulos annos fit.
text_pt: Nesses sacrifícios, porém, cada ano se faz comemoração dos pecados,
text_el: ἀλλ' ἐν αὐταῖς ἀνάμνησις ἁμαρτιῶν κατ' ἐνιαυτόν,

text_en: For it is impossible that with the blood of oxen and goats sin should be taken away.
text_la: Impossibile enim est sanguine taurorum et hircorum auferri peccata.
text_pt: Porque é impossível que o sangue dos touros e dos bodes tire os pecados.
text_el: ἀδύνατον γὰρ αἷμα ταύρων καὶ τράγων ἀφαιρεῖν ἁμαρτίας.

text_en: Wherefore, when he comes into the world he says: Sacrifice and oblation you would not: but a body you have fitted to me.
text_la: Ideo ingrediens mundum dicit : Hostiam et oblationem noluisti : corpus autem aptasti mihi:
text_pt: Por isso, entrando no mundo, diz: Sacrifício e oferta não quiseste, Mas corpo me preparaste;
text_el: διὸ εἰσερχόμενος εἰς τὸν κόσμον λέγει, θυσίαν καὶ προσφορὰν οὐκ ἠθέλησας, σῶμα δὲ κατηρτίσω μοι:

text_en: Holocausts for sin did not please you.
text_la: holocautomata pro peccato non tibi placuerunt.
text_pt: Holocaustos e oblações pelo pecado não te agradaram.
text_el: ὁλοκαυτώματα καὶ περὶ ἁμαρτίας οὐκ εὐδόκησας:

text_en: Then said I: Behold I come: in the head of the book it is written of me: that I should do your will, O God .
text_la: Tunc dixi : Ecce venio : in capite libri scriptum est de me : Ut faciam, Deus, voluntatem tuam.
text_pt: Então disse: Eis aqui venho(No princípio do livro está escrito de mim),Para fazer, ó Deus, a tua vontade.
text_el: τότε εἶπον, ἰδοὺ ἥκω, ἐν κεφαλίδι βιβλίου γέγραπται περὶ ἐμοῦ, τοῦ ποιῆσαι, ὁ θεός, τὸ θέλημά σου.

text_en: In saying before, Sacrifices , and oblations , and holocausts for sin you would not, neither are they pleasing to you, which are offered according to the law .
text_la: Superius dicens : Quia hostias, et oblationes, et holocautomata pro peccato noluisti, nec placita sunt tibi, quæ secundum legem offeruntur,
text_pt: Como acima diz: Sacrifício e oferta, e holocaustos e oblações pelo pecado não quiseste, nem te agradaram (os quais se oferecem segundo a lei).
text_el: ἀνώτερον λέγων ὅτι θυσίας καὶ προσφορὰς καὶ ὁλοκαυτώματα καὶ περὶ ἁμαρτίας οὐκ ἠθέλησας οὐδὲ εὐδόκησας, αἵτινες κατὰ νόμον προσφέρονται,

text_en: Then said I: Behold, I come to do your will, O God : He takes away the first, that he may establish that which follows.
text_la: tunc dixi : Ecce venio, ut faciam, Deus, voluntatem tuam : aufert primum, ut sequens statuat.
text_pt: Então disse: Eis aqui venho, para fazer, ó Deus, a tua vontade. Tira o primeiro, para estabelecer o segundo.
text_el: τότε εἴρηκεν, ἰδοὺ ἥκω τοῦ ποιῆσαι τὸ θέλημά σου. ἀναιρεῖ τὸ πρῶτον ἵνα τὸ δεύτερον στήσῃ:

text_en: In the which will, we are sanctified by the oblation of the body of Jesus Christ once.
text_la: In qua voluntate sanctificati sumus per oblationem corporis Jesu Christi semel.
text_pt: Na qual vontade temos sido santificados pela oblação do corpo de Jesus Cristo, feita uma vez.
text_el: ἐν ᾧ θελήματι ἡγιασμένοι ἐσμὲν διὰ τῆς προσφορᾶς τοῦ σώματος Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ ἐφάπαξ.

text_en: And every priest indeed stands daily ministering and often offering the same sacrifices which can never take away sins .
text_la: Et omnis quidem sacerdos præsto est quotidie ministrans, et easdem sæpe offerens hostias, quæ numquam possunt auferre peccata:
text_pt: E assim todo o sacerdote aparece cada dia, ministrando e oferecendo muitas vezes os mesmos sacrifícios, que nunca podem tirar os pecados;
text_el: Καὶ πᾶς μὲν ἱερεὺς ἕστηκεν καθ' ἡμέραν λειτουργῶν καὶ τὰς αὐτὰς πολλάκις προσφέρων θυσίας, αἵτινες οὐδέποτε δύνανται περιελεῖν ἁμαρτίας.

text_en: But this man , offering one sacrifice for sins , for ever sits on the right hand of God ,
text_la: hic autem unam pro peccatis offerens hostiam, in sempiternum sedet in dextera Dei,
text_pt: Mas este, havendo oferecido para sempre um único sacrifício pelos pecados, está assentado à destra de Deus,
text_el: οὗτος δὲ μίαν ὑπὲρ ἁμαρτιῶν προσενέγκας θυσίαν εἰς τὸ διηνεκὲς ἐκάθισεν ἐν δεξιᾷ τοῦ θεοῦ,

text_en: from henceforth expecting until his enemies be made his footstool.
text_la: de cetero exspectans donec ponantur inimici ejus scabellum pedum ejus.
text_pt: Daqui em diante esperando até que os seus inimigos sejam postos por escabelo de seus pés.
text_el: τὸ λοιπὸν ἐκδεχόμενος ἕως τεθῶσιν οἱ ἐχθροὶ αὐτοῦ ὑποπόδιον τῶν ποδῶν αὐτοῦ:

text_en: For by one oblation he has perfected for ever them that are sanctified .
text_la: Una enim oblatione, consummavit in sempiternum sanctificatos.
text_pt: Porque com uma só oblação aperfeiçoou para sempre os que são santificados.
text_el: μιᾷ γὰρ προσφορᾷ τετελείωκεν εἰς τὸ διηνεκὲς τοὺς ἁγιαζομένους.

text_en: And the Holy Ghost also does testify this to us. For after that he said:
text_la: Contestatur autem nos et Spiritus Sanctus. Postquam enim dixit:
text_pt: E também o Espírito Santo no-lo testifica, porque depois de haver dito:
text_el: μαρτυρεῖ δὲ ἡμῖν καὶ τὸ πνεῦμα τὸ ἅγιον: μετὰ γὰρ τὸ εἰρηκέναι,

text_en: And this is the testament which I will make unto them after those days, says the Lord . I will give my laws in their hearts and on their minds will I write them:
text_la: Hoc autem testamentum, quod testabor ad illos post dies illos, dicit Dominus, dando leges meas in cordibus eorum, et in mentibus eorum superscribam eas:
text_pt: Esta é a aliança que farei com eles Depois daqueles dias, diz o Senhor:Porei as minhas leis em seus corações,E as escreverei em seus entendimentos; acrescenta:
text_el: αὕτη ἡ διαθήκη ἣν διαθήσομαι πρὸς αὐτοὺς μετὰ τὰς ἡμέρας ἐκείνας, λέγει κύριος, διδοὺς νόμους μου ἐπὶ καρδίας αὐτῶν, καὶ ἐπὶ τὴν διάνοιαν αὐτῶν ἐπιγράψω αὐτούς,

text_en: And their sins and iniquities I will remember no more.
text_la: et peccatorum, et iniquitatum eorum jam non recordabor amplius.
text_pt: E jamais me lembrarei de seus pecados e de suas iniqüidades.
text_el: καὶ τῶν ἁμαρτιῶν αὐτῶν καὶ τῶν ἀνομιῶν αὐτῶν οὐ μὴ μνησθήσομαι ἔτι.

text_en: Now, where there is a remission of these, there is no more an oblation for sin .
text_la: Ubi autem horum remissio: jam non est oblatio pro peccato.
text_pt: Ora, onde há remissão destes, não há mais oblação pelo pecado.
text_el: ὅπου δὲ ἄφεσις τούτων, οὐκέτι προσφορὰ περὶ ἁμαρτίας.

text_en: Having therefore, brethren, a confidence in the entering into the holies by the blood of Christ :
text_la: Habentes itaque, fratres, fiduciam in introitu sanctorum in sanguine Christi,
text_pt: Tendo, pois, irmãos, ousadia para entrar no santuário, pelo sangue de Jesus,
text_el: Ἔχοντες οὖν, ἀδελφοί, παρρησίαν εἰς τὴν εἴσοδον τῶν ἁγίων ἐν τῷ αἵματι Ἰησοῦ,

text_en: A new and living way which he has dedicated for us through the veil, that is to say, his flesh:
text_la: quam initiavit nobis viam novam, et viventem per velamen, id est, carnem suam,
text_pt: Pelo novo e vivo caminho que ele nos consagrou, pelo véu, isto é, pela sua carne,
text_el: ἣν ἐνεκαίνισεν ἡμῖν ὁδὸν πρόσφατον καὶ ζῶσαν διὰ τοῦ καταπετάσματος, τοῦτ' ἔστιν τῆς σαρκὸς αὐτοῦ,

text_en: And a high priest over the house of God :
text_la: et sacerdotem magnum super domum Dei:
text_pt: E tendo um grande sacerdote sobre a casa de Deus,
text_el: καὶ ἱερέα μέγαν ἐπὶ τὸν οἶκον τοῦ θεοῦ,

text_en: Let us draw near with a true heart, in fullness of faith , having our hearts sprinkled from an evil conscience and our bodies washed with clean water.
text_la: accedamus cum vero corde in plenitudine fidei, aspersi corda a conscientia mala, et abluti corpus aqua munda,
text_pt: Cheguemo-nos com verdadeiro coração, em inteira certeza de fé, tendo os corações purificados da má consciência, e o corpo lavado com água limpa,
text_el: προσερχώμεθα μετὰ ἀληθινῆς καρδίας ἐν πληροφορίᾳ πίστεως, ῥεραντισμένοι τὰς καρδίας ἀπὸ συνειδήσεως πονηρᾶς καὶ λελουσμένοι τὸ σῶμα ὕδατι καθαρῷ,

text_en: Let us hold fast the confession of our hope without wavering (for he is faithful that has promised ):
text_la: teneamus spei nostræ confessionem indeclinabilem (fidelis enim est qui repromisit),
text_pt: Retenhamos firmes a confissão da nossa esperança; porque fiel é o que prometeu.
text_el: κατέχωμεν τὴν ὁμολογίαν τῆς ἐλπίδος ἀκλινῆ, πιστὸς γὰρ ὁ ἐπαγγειλάμενος,

text_en: And let us consider one another, to provoke unto charity and to good works :
text_la: et consideremus invicem in provocationem caritatis, et bonorum operum:
text_pt: E consideremo-nos uns aos outros, para nos estimularmos ao amor e às boas obras,
text_el: καὶ κατανοῶμεν ἀλλήλους εἰς παροξυσμὸν ἀγάπης καὶ καλῶν ἔργων,

text_en: Not forsaking our assembly , as some are accustomed: but comforting one another, and so much the more as you see the day approaching.
text_la: non deserentes collectionem nostram, sicut consuetudinis est quibusdam, sed consolantes, et tanto magis quanto videritis appropinquantem diem.
text_pt: Não deixando a nossa congregação, como é costume de alguns, antes admoestando-nos uns aos outros; e tanto mais, quanto vedes que se vai aproximando aquele dia.
text_el: μὴ ἐγκαταλείποντες τὴν ἐπισυναγωγὴν ἑαυτῶν, καθὼς ἔθος τισίν, ἀλλὰ παρακαλοῦντες, καὶ τοσούτῳ μᾶλλον ὅσῳ βλέπετε ἐγγίζουσαν τὴν ἡμέραν.

text_en: For if we sin wilfully after having the knowledge of the truth , there is now left no sacrifice for sins :
text_la: Voluntarie enim peccantibus nobis post acceptam notitiam veritatis, jam non relinquitur pro peccatis hostia,
text_pt: Porque, se pecarmos voluntariamente, depois de termos recebido o conhecimento da verdade, já não resta mais sacrifício pelos pecados,
text_el: Ἑκουσίως γὰρ ἁμαρτανόντων ἡμῶν μετὰ τὸ λαβεῖν τὴν ἐπίγνωσιν τῆς ἀληθείας, οὐκέτι περὶ ἁμαρτιῶν ἀπολείπεται θυσία,

text_en: But a certain dreadful expectation of judgment , and the rage of a fire which shall consume the adversaries.
text_la: terribilis autem quædam exspectatio judicii, et ignis æmulatio, quæ consumptura est adversarios.
text_pt: Mas uma certa expectação horrível de juízo, e ardor de fogo, que há de devorar os adversários.
text_el: φοβερὰ δέ τις ἐκδοχὴ κρίσεως καὶ πυρὸς ζῆλος ἐσθίειν μέλλοντος τοὺς ὑπεναντίους.

text_en: A man making void the law of Moses dies without any mercy under two or three witnesses :
text_la: Irritam quis faciens legem Moysi, sine ulla miseratione duobus vel tribus testibus moritur:
text_pt: Quebrantando alguém a lei de Moisés, morre sem misericórdia, só pela palavra de duas ou três testemunhas.
text_el: ἀθετήσας τις νόμον Μωϋσέως χωρὶς οἰκτιρμῶν ἐπὶ δυσὶν ἢ τρισὶν μάρτυσιν ἀποθνῄσκει:

text_en: How much more, do you think he deserves worse punishments, who has trodden under foot the Son of God and has esteemed the blood of the testament unclean , by which he was sanctified , and has offered an affront to the Spirit of grace ?
text_la: quanto magis putatis deteriora mereri supplicia qui Filium Dei conculcaverit, et sanguinem testamenti pollutum duxerit, in quo sanctificatus est, et spiritui gratiæ contumeliam fecerit?
text_pt: De quanto maior castigo cuidais vós será julgado merecedor aquele que pisar o Filho de Deus, e tiver por profano o sangue da aliança com que foi santificado, e fizer agravo ao Espírito da graça?
text_el: πόσῳ δοκεῖτε χείρονος ἀξιωθήσεται τιμωρίας ὁ τὸν υἱὸν τοῦ θεοῦ καταπατήσας, καὶ τὸ αἷμα τῆς διαθήκης κοινὸν ἡγησάμενος ἐν ᾧ ἡγιάσθη, καὶ τὸ πνεῦμα τῆς χάριτος ἐνυβρίσας;

text_en: For we know him that has said: Vengeance belongs to me, and I will repay. And again: The Lord shall judge his people.
text_la: Scimus enim qui dixit : Mihi vindicta, et ego retribuam. Et iterum : Quia judicabit Dominus populum suum.
text_pt: Porque bem conhecemos aquele que disse: Minha é a vingança, eu darei a recompensa, diz o Senhor. E outra vez: O Senhor julgará o seu povo.
text_el: οἴδαμεν γὰρ τὸν εἰπόντα, ἐμοὶ ἐκδίκησις, ἐγὼ ἀνταποδώσω: καὶ πάλιν, κρινεῖ κύριος τὸν λαὸν αὐτοῦ.

text_en: It is a fearful thing to fall into the hands of the living God .
text_la: Horrendum est incidere in manus Dei viventis.
text_pt: Horrenda coisa é cair nas mãos do Deus vivo.
text_el: φοβερὸν τὸ ἐμπεσεῖν εἰς χεῖρας θεοῦ ζῶντος.

text_en: But call to mind the former days, wherein, being illuminated, you endured a great fight of afflictions.
text_la: Rememoramini autem pristinos dies, in quibus illuminati, magnum certamen sustinuistis passionum:
text_pt: Lembrai-vos, porém, dos dias passados, em que, depois de serdes iluminados, suportastes grande combate de aflições.
text_el: Ἀναμιμνῄσκεσθε δὲ τὰς πρότερον ἡμέρας, ἐν αἷς φωτισθέντες πολλὴν ἄθλησιν ὑπεμείνατε παθημάτων,

text_en: And on the one hand indeed, by reproaches and tribulations, were made a gazingstock; and on the other, became companions of them that were used in such sort.
text_la: et in altero quidem opprobriis et tribulationibus spectaculum facti: in altero autem socii taliter conversantium effecti.
text_pt: Em parte fostes feitos espetáculo com vitupérios e tribulações, e em parte fostes participantes com os que assim foram tratados.
text_el: τοῦτο μὲν ὀνειδισμοῖς τε καὶ θλίψεσιν θεατριζόμενοι, τοῦτο δὲ κοινωνοὶ τῶν οὕτως ἀναστρεφομένων γενηθέντες:

text_en: For you both had compassion on them that were in bands and took with joy the being stripped of your own goods , knowing that you have a better and a lasting substance.
text_la: Nam et vinctis compassi estis, et rapinam bonorum vestrorum cum gaudio suscepistis, cognoscentes vos habere meliorem et manentem substantiam.
text_pt: Porque também vos compadecestes das minhas prisões, e com alegria permitistes o roubo dos vossos bens, sabendo que em vós mesmos tendes nos céus uma possessão melhor e permanente.
text_el: καὶ γὰρ τοῖς δεσμίοις συνεπαθήσατε, καὶ τὴν ἁρπαγὴν τῶν ὑπαρχόντων ὑμῶν μετὰ χαρᾶς προσεδέξασθε, γινώσκοντες ἔχειν ἑαυτοὺς κρείττονα ὕπαρξιν καὶ μένουσαν.

text_en: Do not therefore lose your confidence which has a great reward.
text_la: Nolite itaque amittere confidentiam vestram, quæ magnam habet remunerationem.
text_pt: Não rejeiteis, pois, a vossa confiança, que tem grande e avultado galardão.
text_el: μὴ ἀποβάλητε οὖν τὴν παρρησίαν ὑμῶν, ἥτις ἔχει μεγάλην μισθαποδοσίαν,

text_en: For patience is necessary for you: that, doing the will of God , you may receive the promise .
text_la: Patientia enim vobis necessaria est : ut voluntatem Dei facientes, reportetis promissionem.
text_pt: Porque necessitais de paciência, para que, depois de haverdes feito a vontade de Deus, possais alcançar a promessa.
text_el: ὑπομονῆς γὰρ ἔχετε χρείαν ἵνα τὸ θέλημα τοῦ θεοῦ ποιήσαντες κομίσησθε τὴν ἐπαγγελίαν.

text_en: For yet a little and a very little while, and he that is to come will come and will not delay.
text_la: Adhuc enim modicum aliquantulum, qui venturus est, veniet, et non tardabit.
text_pt: Porque ainda um pouquinho de tempo, E o que há de vir virá, e não tardará.
text_el: ἔτι γὰρ μικρὸν ὅσον ὅσον, ὁ ἐρχόμενος ἥξει καὶ οὐ χρονίσει:

text_en: But my just man lives by faith : but if he withdraw himself, he shall not please my soul .
text_la: Justus autem meus ex fide vivit : quod si subtraxerit se, non placebit animæ meæ.
text_pt: Mas o justo viverá pela fé; E, se ele recuar, a minha alma não tem prazer nele.
text_el: ὁ δὲ δίκαιός [μου] ἐκ πίστεως ζήσεται, καὶ ἐὰν ὑποστείληται, οὐκ εὐδοκεῖ ἡ ψυχή μου ἐν αὐτῷ.

text_en: But we are not the children of withdrawing unto perdition , but of faith to the saving of the soul .
text_la: Nos autem non sumus subtractionis filii in perditionem, sed fidei in acquisitionem animæ.
text_pt: Nós, porém, não somos daqueles que se retiram para a perdição, mas daqueles que crêem para a conservação da alma.
text_el: ἡμεῖς δὲ οὐκ ἐσμὲν ὑποστολῆς εἰς ἀπώλειαν, ἀλλὰ πίστεως εἰς περιποίησιν ψυχῆς.

text_en: Now, faith is the substance of things to be hoped for, the evidence of things that appear not.
text_la: Est autem fides sperandarum substantia rerum, argumentum non apparentium.
text_pt: Ora, a fé é o firme fundamento das coisas que se esperam, e a prova das coisas que se não vêem.
text_el: Ἔστιν δὲ πίστις ἐλπιζομένων ὑπόστασις, πραγμάτων ἔλεγχος οὐ βλεπομένων.

text_en: For by this the ancients obtained a testimony.
text_la: In hac enim testimonium consecuti sunt senes.
text_pt: Porque por ela os antigos alcançaram testemunho.
text_el: ἐν ταύτῃ γὰρ ἐμαρτυρήθησαν οἱ πρεσβύτεροι.

text_en: By faith we understand that the world was framed by the word of God : that from invisible things visible things might be made.
text_la: Fide intelligimus aptata esse sæcula verbo Dei : ut ex invisibilibus visibilia fierent.
text_pt: Pela fé entendemos que os mundos pela palavra de Deus foram criados; de maneira que aquilo que se vê não foi feito do que é aparente.
text_el: Πίστει νοοῦμεν κατηρτίσθαι τοὺς αἰῶνας ῥήματι θεοῦ, εἰς τὸ μὴ ἐκ φαινομένων τὸ βλεπόμενον γεγονέναι.

text_en: By faith Abel offered to God a sacrifice exceeding that of Cain , by which he obtained a testimony that he was just , God giving testimony to his gifts. And by it he being dead yet speaks.
text_la: Fide plurimam hostiam Abel, quam Cain, obtulit Deo, per quam testimonium consecutus est esse justus, testimonium perhibente muneribus ejus Deo, et per illam defunctus adhuc loquitur.
text_pt: Pela fé Abel ofereceu a Deus maior sacrifício do que Caim, pelo qual alcançou testemunho de que era justo, dando Deus testemunho dos seus dons, e por ela, depois de morto, ainda fala.
text_el: Πίστει πλείονα θυσίαν Ἅβελ παρὰ Κάϊν προσήνεγκεν τῷ θεῷ, δι' ἧς ἐμαρτυρήθη εἶναι δίκαιος, μαρτυροῦντος ἐπὶ τοῖς δώροις αὐτοῦ τοῦ θεοῦ, καὶ δι' αὐτῆς ἀποθανὼν ἔτι λαλεῖ.

text_en: By faith Henoch was translated that he should not see death: and he was not found because God had translated him. For before his translation he had testimony that he pleased God .
text_la: Fide Henoch translatus est ne videret mortem, et non inveniebatur, quia transtulit illum Deus : ante translationem enim testimonium habuit placuisse Deo.
text_pt: Pela fé Enoque foi trasladado para não ver a morte, e não foi achado, porque Deus o trasladara; visto como antes da sua trasladação alcançou testemunho de que agradara a Deus.
text_el: Πίστει Ἑνὼχ μετετέθη τοῦ μὴ ἰδεῖν θάνατον, καὶ οὐχ ηὑρίσκετο διότι μετέθηκεν αὐτὸν ὁ θεός. πρὸ γὰρ τῆς μεταθέσεως μεμαρτύρηται εὐαρεστηκέναι τῷ θεῷ:

text_en: But without faith it is impossible to please God . For he that comes to God must believe that he is: and is a rewarder to them that seek him.
text_la: Sine fide autem impossibile est placere Deo. Credere enim oportet accedentem ad Deum quia est, et inquirentibus se remunerator sit.
text_pt: Ora, sem fé é impossível agradar-lhe; porque é necessário que aquele que se aproxima de Deus creia que ele existe, e que é galardoador dos que o buscam.
text_el: χωρὶς δὲ πίστεως ἀδύνατον εὐαρεστῆσαι, πιστεῦσαι γὰρ δεῖ τὸν προσερχόμενον [τῷ] θεῷ, ὅτι ἔστιν καὶ τοῖς ἐκζητοῦσιν αὐτὸν μισθαποδότης γίνεται.

text_en: By faith Noe , having received an answer concerning those things which as yet were not seen, moved with fear , framed the ark for the saving of his house : by the which he condemned the world and was instituted heir of the justice which is by faith .
text_la: Fide Noë responso accepto de iis quæ adhuc non videbantur, metuens aptavit arcam in salutem domus suæ, per quam damnavit mundum : et justitiæ, quæ per fidem est, hæres est institutus.
text_pt: Pela fé Noé, divinamente avisado das coisas que ainda não se viam, temeu e, para salvação da sua família, preparou a arca, pela qual condenou o mundo, e foi feito herdeiro da justiça que é segundo a fé.
text_el: Πίστει χρηματισθεὶς Νῶε περὶ τῶν μηδέπω βλεπομένων εὐλαβηθεὶς κατεσκεύασεν κιβωτὸν εἰς σωτηρίαν τοῦ οἴκου αὐτοῦ, δι' ἧς κατέκρινεν τὸν κόσμον, καὶ τῆς κατὰ πίστιν δικαιοσύνης ἐγένετο κληρονόμος.

text_en: By faith he that is called Abraham obeyed to go out into a place which he was to receive for an inheritance. And he went out, not knowing whither he went.
text_la: Fide qui vocatur Abraham obedivit in locum exire, quem accepturus erat in hæreditatem : et exiit, nesciens quo iret.
text_pt: Pela fé Abraão, sendo chamado, obedeceu, indo para um lugar que havia de receber por herança; e saiu, sem saber para onde ia.
text_el: Πίστει καλούμενος Ἀβραὰμ ὑπήκουσεν ἐξελθεῖν εἰς τόπον ὃν ἤμελλεν λαμβάνειν εἰς κληρονομίαν, καὶ ἐξῆλθεν μὴ ἐπιστάμενος ποῦ ἔρχεται.

text_en: By faith he abode in the land of promise , as in a strange country, dwelling in cottages, with Isaac and Jacob , the co-heirs of the same promise .
text_la: Fide demoratus est in terra repromissionis, tamquam in aliena, in casulis habitando cum Isaac et Jacob cohæredibus repromissionis ejusdem.
text_pt: Pela fé habitou na terra da promessa, como em terra alheia, morando em cabanas com Isaque e Jacó, herdeiros com ele da mesma promessa.
text_el: πίστει παρῴκησεν εἰς γῆν τῆς ἐπαγγελίας ὡς ἀλλοτρίαν, ἐν σκηναῖς κατοικήσας μετὰ Ἰσαὰκ καὶ Ἰακὼβ τῶν συγκληρονόμων τῆς ἐπαγγελίας τῆς αὐτῆς:

text_en: For he looked for a city that has foundations: whose builder and maker is God .
text_la: Exspectabat enim fundamenta habentem civitatem : cujus artifex et conditor Deus.
text_pt: Porque esperava a cidade que tem fundamentos, da qual o artífice e construtor é Deus.
text_el: ἐξεδέχετο γὰρ τὴν τοὺς θεμελίους ἔχουσαν πόλιν, ἧς τεχνίτης καὶ δημιουργὸς ὁ θεός.

text_en: By faith also Sara herself, being barren, received strength to conceive seed, even past the time of age: because she believed that he was faithful who had promised ,
text_la: Fide et ipsa Sara sterilis virtutem in conceptionem seminis accepit, etiam præter tempus ætatis : quoniam fidelem credidit esse eum qui repromiserat.
text_pt: Pela fé também a mesma Sara recebeu a virtude de conceber, e deu à luz já fora da idade; porquanto teve por fiel aquele que lho tinha prometido.
text_el: Πίστει καὶ αὐτὴ Σάρρα δύναμιν εἰς καταβολὴν σπέρματος ἔλαβεν καὶ παρὰ καιρὸν ἡλικίας, ἐπεὶ πιστὸν ἡγήσατο τὸν ἐπαγγειλάμενον.

text_en: for which cause there sprung even from one (and him as good as dead) as the stars of heaven in multitude and as the sand which is by the sea shore innumerable.
text_la: Propter quod et ab uno orti sunt (et hoc emortuo) tamquam sidera cæli in multitudinem, et sicut arena, quæ est ad oram maris, innumerabilis.
text_pt: Por isso também de um, e esse já amortecido, descenderam tantos, em multidão, como as estrelas do céu, e como a areia inumerável que está na praia do mar.
text_el: διὸ καὶ ἀφ' ἑνὸς ἐγεννήθησαν, καὶ ταῦτα νενεκρωμένου, καθὼς τὰ ἄστρα τοῦ οὐρανοῦ τῷ πλήθει καὶ ὡς ἡ ἄμμος ἡ παρὰ τὸ χεῖλος τῆς θαλάσσης ἡ ἀναρίθμητος.

text_en: All these died according to faith , not having received the promises but beholding them afar off and saluting them and confessing that they are pilgrims and strangers on the earth.
text_la: Juxta fidem defuncti sunt omnes isti, non acceptis repromissionibus, sed a longe eas aspicientes, et salutantes, et confitentes quia peregrini et hospites sunt super terram.
text_pt: Todos estes morreram na fé, sem terem recebido as promessas; mas vendo-as de longe, e crendo-as e abraçando-as, confessaram que eram estrangeiros e peregrinos na terra.
text_el: Κατὰ πίστιν ἀπέθανον οὗτοι πάντες, μὴ κομισάμενοι τὰς ἐπαγγελίας, ἀλλὰ πόρρωθεν αὐτὰς ἰδόντες καὶ ἀσπασάμενοι, καὶ ὁμολογήσαντες ὅτι ξένοι καὶ παρεπίδημοί εἰσιν ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς:

text_en: For they that say these things do signify that they seek a country.
text_la: Qui enim hæc dicunt, significant se patriam inquirere.
text_pt: Porque, os que isto dizem, claramente mostram que buscam uma pátria.
text_el: οἱ γὰρ τοιαῦτα λέγοντες ἐμφανίζουσιν ὅτι πατρίδα ἐπιζητοῦσιν.

text_en: And truly , if they had been mindful of that from whence they came out, they had doubtless, time to return.
text_la: Et si quidem ipsius meminissent de qua exierunt, habebant utique tempus revertendi:
text_pt: E se, na verdade, se lembrassem daquela de onde haviam saído, teriam oportunidade de tornar.
text_el: καὶ εἰ μὲν ἐκείνης ἐμνημόνευον ἀφ' ἧς ἐξέβησαν, εἶχον ἂν καιρὸν ἀνακάμψαι:

text_en: But now they desire a better, that is to say, a heavenly country. Therefore, God is not ashamed to be called their God : for he has prepared for them a city.
text_la: nunc autem meliorem appetunt, id est, cælestem. Ideo non confunditur Deus vocari Deus eorum : paravit enim illis civitatem.
text_pt: Mas agora desejam uma melhor, isto é, a celestial. Por isso também Deus não se envergonha deles, de se chamar seu Deus, porque já lhes preparou uma cidade.
text_el: νῦν δὲ κρείττονος ὀρέγονται, τοῦτ' ἔστιν ἐπουρανίου. διὸ οὐκ ἐπαισχύνεται αὐτοὺς ὁ θεὸς θεὸς ἐπικαλεῖσθαι αὐτῶν, ἡτοίμασεν γὰρ αὐτοῖς πόλιν.

text_en: By faith Abraham , when he was tried, offered Isaac : and he that had received the promises offered up his only begotten son,
text_la: Fide obtulit Abraham Isaac, cum tentaretur, et unigenitum offerebat, qui susceperat repromissiones:
text_pt: Pela fé ofereceu Abraão a Isaque, quando foi provado; sim, aquele que recebera as promessas ofereceu o seu unigênito.
text_el: Πίστει προσενήνοχεν Ἀβραὰμ τὸν Ἰσαὰκ πειραζόμενος, καὶ τὸν μονογενῆ προσέφερεν ὁ τὰς ἐπαγγελίας ἀναδεξάμενος,

text_en: (to whom it was said: In Isaac shall your seed be called):
text_la: ad quem dictum est : Quia in Isaac vocabitur tibi semen:
text_pt: Sendo-lhe dito: Em Isaque será chamada a tua descendência, considerou que Deus era poderoso para até dentre os mortos o ressuscitar;
text_el: πρὸς ὃν ἐλαλήθη ὅτι ἐν Ἰσαὰκ κληθήσεταί σοι σπέρμα,

text_en: accounting that God is able to raise up even from the dead. Whereupon also he received him for a parable .
text_la: arbitrans quia et a mortuis suscitare potens est Deus : unde eum et in parabolam accepit.
text_pt: E daí também em figura ele o recobrou.
text_el: λογισάμενος ὅτι καὶ ἐκ νεκρῶν ἐγείρειν δυνατὸς ὁ θεός: ὅθεν αὐτὸν καὶ ἐν παραβολῇ ἐκομίσατο.

text_en: By faith also of things to come Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau .
text_la: Fide et de futuris benedixit Isaac Jacob et Esau.
text_pt: Pela fé Isaque abençoou Jacó e Esaú, no tocante às coisas futuras.
text_el: πίστει καὶ περὶ μελλόντων εὐλόγησεν Ἰσαὰκ τὸν Ἰακὼβ καὶ τὸν Ἠσαῦ.

text_en: By faith Jacob , dying, blessed each of the sons of Joseph and adored the top of his rod.
text_la: Fide Jacob, moriens, singulos filiorum Joseph benedixit : et adoravit fastigium virgæ ejus.
text_pt: Pela fé Jacó, próximo da morte, abençoou cada um dos filhos de José, e adorou encostado à ponta do seu bordão.
text_el: πίστει Ἰακὼβ ἀποθνῄσκων ἕκαστον τῶν υἱῶν Ἰωσὴφ εὐλόγησεν, καὶ προσεκύνησεν ἐπὶ τὸ ἄκρον τῆς ῥάβδου αὐτοῦ.

text_en: By faith Joseph , when he was dying, made mention of the going out of the children of Israel and gave commandment concerning his bones.
text_la: Fide Joseph, moriens, de profectione filiorum Israël memoratus est, et de ossibus suis mandavit.
text_pt: Pela fé José, próximo da morte, fez menção da saída dos filhos de Israel, e deu ordem acerca de seus ossos.
text_el: πίστει Ἰωσὴφ τελευτῶν περὶ τῆς ἐξόδου τῶν υἱῶν Ἰσραὴλ ἐμνημόνευσεν, καὶ περὶ τῶν ὀστέων αὐτοῦ ἐνετείλατο.

text_en: By faith Moses , when he was born, was hid three months by his parents : because they saw he was a comely babe, and they feared not the king's edict.
text_la: Fide Moyses, natus, occultatus est mensibus tribus a parentibus suis, eo quod vidissent elegantem infantem, et non timuerunt regis edictum.
text_pt: Pela fé Moisés, já nascido, foi escondido três meses por seus pais, porque viram que era um menino formoso; e não temeram o mandamento do rei.
text_el: Πίστει Μωϋσῆς γεννηθεὶς ἐκρύβη τρίμηνον ὑπὸ τῶν πατέρων αὐτοῦ, διότι εἶδον ἀστεῖον τὸ παιδίον, καὶ οὐκ ἐφοβήθησαν τὸ διάταγμα τοῦ βασιλέως.

text_en: By faith Moses , when he was grown up, denied himself to be the son of Pharao's daughter:
text_la: Fide Moyses grandis factus negavit se esse filium filiæ Pharaonis,
text_pt: Pela fé Moisés, sendo já grande, recusou ser chamado filho da filha de Faraó,
text_el: πίστει Μωϋσῆς μέγας γενόμενος ἠρνήσατο λέγεσθαι υἱὸς θυγατρὸς Φαραώ,

text_en: Rather choosing to be afflicted with the people of God than to have the pleasure of sin for a time:
text_la: magis eligens affligi cum populo Dei, quam temporalis peccati habere jucunditatem,
text_pt: Escolhendo antes ser maltratado com o povo de Deus, do que por um pouco de tempo ter o gozo do pecado;
text_el: μᾶλλον ἑλόμενος συγκακουχεῖσθαι τῷ λαῷ τοῦ θεοῦ ἢ πρόσκαιρον ἔχειν ἁμαρτίας ἀπόλαυσιν,

text_en: Esteeming the reproach of Christ greater riches than the treasure of the Egyptians . For he looked unto the reward.
text_la: majores divitias æstimans thesauro Ægyptiorum, improperium Christi : aspiciebat enim in remunerationem.
text_pt: Tendo por maiores riquezas o vitupério de Cristo do que os tesouros do Egito; porque tinha em vista a recompensa.
text_el: μείζονα πλοῦτον ἡγησάμενος τῶν Αἰγύπτου θησαυρῶν τὸν ὀνειδισμὸν τοῦ Χριστοῦ, ἀπέβλεπεν γὰρ εἰς τὴν μισθαποδοσίαν.

text_en: By faith he left Egypt , not fearing the fierceness of the king: for he endured, as seeing him that is invisible.
text_la: Fide reliquit Ægyptum, non veritus animositatem regis : invisibilem enim tamquam videns sustinuit.
text_pt: Pela fé deixou o Egito, não temendo a ira do rei; porque ficou firme, como vendo o invisível.
text_el: πίστει κατέλιπεν Αἴγυπτον, μὴ φοβηθεὶς τὸν θυμὸν τοῦ βασιλέως, τὸν γὰρ ἀόρατον ὡς ὁρῶν ἐκαρτέρησεν.

text_en: By faith he celebrated the pasch and the shedding of the blood: that he who destroyed the firstborn might not touch them.
text_la: Fide celebravit Pascha, et sanguinis effusionem : ne qui vastabat primitiva, tangeret eos.
text_pt: Pela fé celebrou a páscoa e a aspersão do sangue, para que o destruidor dos primogênitos lhes não tocasse.
text_el: πίστει πεποίηκεν τὸ πάσχα καὶ τὴν πρόσχυσιν τοῦ αἵματος, ἵνα μὴ ὁ ὀλοθρεύων τὰ πρωτότοκα θίγῃ αὐτῶν.

text_en: By faith they passed through the Red Sea , as by dry land: which the Egyptians attempting, were swallowed up.
text_la: Fide transierunt mare Rubrum tamquam per aridam terram : quod experti Ægyptii, devorati sunt.
text_pt: Pela fé passaram o Mar Vermelho, como por terra seca; o que intentando os egípcios, se afogaram.
text_el: πίστει διέβησαν τὴν ἐρυθρὰν θάλασσαν ὡς διὰ ξηρᾶς γῆς, ἧς πεῖραν λαβόντες οἱ Αἰγύπτιοι κατεπόθησαν.

text_en: By faith the walls of Jericho fell down, by the going round them seven days.
text_la: Fide muri Jericho corruerunt, circuitu dierum septem.
text_pt: Pela fé caíram os muros de Jericó, sendo rodeados durante sete dias.
text_el: πίστει τὰ τείχη Ἰεριχὼ ἔπεσαν κυκλωθέντα ἐπὶ ἑπτὰ ἡμέρας.

text_en: By faith Rahab the harlot perished not with the unbelievers, receiving the spies with peace.
text_la: Fide Rahab meretrix non periit cum incredulis, excipiens exploratores cum pace.
text_pt: Pela fé Raabe, a meretriz, não pereceu com os incrédulos, acolhendo em paz os espias.
text_el: πίστει Ῥαὰβ ἡ πόρνη οὐ συναπώλετο τοῖς ἀπειθήσασιν, δεξαμένη τοὺς κατασκόπους μετ' εἰρήνης.

text_en: And what shall I yet say? For the time would fail me to tell of Gedeon , Barac , Samson , Jephthe , David , Samuel , and the prophets :
text_la: Et quid adhuc dicam? deficiet enim me tempus enarrantem de Gedeon, Barac, Samson, Jephte, David, Samuel, et prophetis:
text_pt: E que mais direi? Faltar-me-ia o tempo contando de Gideão, e de Baraque, e de Sansão, e de Jefté, e de Davi, e de Samuel e dos profetas,
text_el: Καὶ τί ἔτι λέγω; ἐπιλείψει με γὰρ διηγούμενον ὁ χρόνος περὶ Γεδεών, Βαράκ, Σαμψών, Ἰεφθάε, Δαυίδ τε καὶ Σαμουὴλ καὶ τῶν προφητῶν,

text_en: Who by faith conquered kingdoms, wrought justice , obtained promises, stopped the mouths of lions,
text_la: qui per fidem vicerunt regna, operati sunt justitiam, adepti sunt repromissiones, obturaverunt ora leonum,
text_pt: Os quais pela fé venceram reinos, praticaram a justiça, alcançaram promessas, fecharam as bocas dos leões,
text_el: οἳ διὰ πίστεως κατηγωνίσαντο βασιλείας, εἰργάσαντο δικαιοσύνην, ἐπέτυχον ἐπαγγελιῶν, ἔφραξαν στόματα λεόντων,

text_en: quenched the violence of fire, escaped the edge of the sword, recovered strength from weakness, became valiant in battle, put to flight the armies of foreigners.
text_la: extinxerunt impetum ignis, effugerunt aciem gladii, convaluerunt de infirmitate, fortes facti sunt in bello, castra verterunt exterorum:
text_pt: Apagaram a força do fogo, escaparam do fio da espada, da fraqueza tiraram forças, na batalha se esforçaram, puseram em fuga os exércitos dos estranhos.
text_el: ἔσβεσαν δύναμιν πυρός, ἔφυγον στόματα μαχαίρης, ἐδυναμώθησαν ἀπὸ ἀσθενείας, ἐγενήθησαν ἰσχυροὶ ἐν πολέμῳ, παρεμβολὰς ἔκλιναν ἀλλοτρίων:

text_en: Women received their dead raised to life again . But others were racked, not accepting deliverance, that they might find a better resurrection .
text_la: acceperunt mulieres de resurrectione mortuos suos: alii autem distenti sunt non suscipientes redemptionem ut meliorem invenirent resurrectionem.
text_pt: As mulheres receberam pela ressurreição os seus mortos; uns foram torturados, não aceitando o seu livramento, para alcançarem uma melhor ressurreição;
text_el: ἔλαβον γυναῖκες ἐξ ἀναστάσεως τοὺς νεκροὺς αὐτῶν: ἄλλοι δὲ ἐτυμπανίσθησαν, οὐ προσδεξάμενοι τὴν ἀπολύτρωσιν, ἵνα κρείττονος ἀναστάσεως τύχωσιν:

text_en: And others had trial of mockeries and stripes: moreover also of bands and prisons .
text_la: Alii vero ludibria, et verbera experti, insuper et vincula, et carceres:
text_pt: E outros experimentaram escárnios e açoites, e até cadeias e prisões.
text_el: ἕτεροι δὲ ἐμπαιγμῶν καὶ μαστίγων πεῖραν ἔλαβον, ἔτι δὲ δεσμῶν καὶ φυλακῆς:

text_en: They were stoned , they were cut asunder, they were tempted , they were put to death by the sword, they wandered about in sheepskins, in goatskins, being in want, distressed, afflicted:
text_la: lapidati sunt, secti sunt, tentati sunt, in occisione gladii mortui sunt, circuierunt in melotis, in pellibus caprinis, egentes, angustiati, afflicti:
text_pt: Foram apedrejados, serrados, tentados, mortos ao fio da espada; andaram vestidos de peles de ovelhas e de cabras, desamparados, aflitos e maltratados
text_el: ἐλιθάσθησαν, ἐπειράσθησαν ἐπρίσθησαν, ἐν φόνῳ μαχαίρης ἀπέθανον, περιῆλθον ἐν μηλωταῖς, ἐν αἰγείοις δέρμασιν, ὑστερούμενοι, θλιβόμενοι, κακουχούμενοι,

text_en: Of whom the world was not worthy: wandering in deserts , in mountains and in dens and in caves of the earth.
text_la: quibus dignus non erat mundus : in solitudinibus errantes, in montibus, in speluncis, et in cavernis terræ.
text_pt: (Dos quais o mundo não era digno), errantes pelos desertos, e montes, e pelas covas e cavernas da terra.
text_el: ὧν οὐκ ἦν ἄξιος ὁ κόσμος, ἐπὶ ἐρημίαις πλανώμενοι καὶ ὄρεσιν καὶ σπηλαίοις καὶ ταῖς ὀπαῖς τῆς γῆς.

text_en: And all these, being approved by the testimony of faith , received not the promise :
text_la: Et hi omnes testimonio fidei probati, non acceperunt repromissionem,
text_pt: E todos estes, tendo tido testemunho pela fé, não alcançaram a promessa,
text_el: καὶ οὗτοι πάντες μαρτυρηθέντες διὰ τῆς πίστεως οὐκ ἐκομίσαντο τὴν ἐπαγγελίαν,

text_en: God providing some better thing for us, that they should not be perfected without us.
text_la: Deo pro nobis melius aliquid providente, ut non sine nobis consummarentur.
text_pt: Provendo Deus alguma coisa melhor a nosso respeito, para que eles sem nós não fossem aperfeiçoados.
text_el: τοῦ θεοῦ περὶ ἡμῶν κρεῖττόν τι προβλεψαμένου, ἵνα μὴ χωρὶς ἡμῶν τελειωθῶσιν.

text_en: And therefore we also having so great a cloud of witnesses over our head, laying aside every weight and sin which surrounds us, let us run by patience to the fight proposed to us:
text_la: Ideoque et nos tantam habentes impositam nubem testium, deponentes omne pondus, et circumstans nos peccatum, per patientiam curramus ad propositum nobis certamen:
text_pt: Portanto nós também, pois que estamos rodeados de uma tão grande nuvem de testemunhas, deixemos todo o embaraço, e o pecado que tão de perto nos rodeia, e corramos com paciência a carreira que nos está proposta,
text_el: Τοιγαροῦν καὶ ἡμεῖς, τοσοῦτον ἔχοντες περικείμενον ἡμῖν νέφος μαρτύρων, ὄγκον ἀποθέμενοι πάντα καὶ τὴν εὐπερίστατον ἁμαρτίαν, δι' ὑπομονῆς τρέχωμεν τὸν προκείμενον ἡμῖν ἀγῶνα,

text_en: Looking on Jesus , the author and finisher of faith , who, having joy set before him, endured the cross , despising the shame, and now sits on the right hand of the throne of God .
text_la: aspicientes in auctorem fidei, et consummatorem Jesum, qui proposito sibi gaudio sustinuit crucem, confusione contempta, atque in dextera sedis Dei sedet.
text_pt: Olhando para Jesus, autor e consumador da fé, o qual, pelo gozo que lhe estava proposto, suportou a cruz, desprezando a afronta, e assentou-se à destra do trono de Deus.
text_el: ἀφορῶντες εἰς τὸν τῆς πίστεως ἀρχηγὸν καὶ τελειωτὴν Ἰησοῦν, ὃς ἀντὶ τῆς προκειμένης αὐτῷ χαρᾶς ὑπέμεινεν σταυρὸν αἰσχύνης καταφρονήσας, ἐν δεξιᾷ τε τοῦ θρόνου τοῦ θεοῦ κεκάθικεν.

text_en: For think diligently upon him that endured such opposition from sinners against himself that you be not wearied, fainting in your minds .
text_la: Recogitate enim eum qui talem sustinuit a peccatoribus adversum semetipsum contradictionem : ut ne fatigemini, animis vestris deficientes.
text_pt: Considerai, pois, aquele que suportou tais contradições dos pecadores contra si mesmo, para que não enfraqueçais, desfalecendo em vossos ânimos.
text_el: ἀναλογίσασθε γὰρ τὸν τοιαύτην ὑπομεμενηκότα ὑπὸ τῶν ἁμαρτωλῶν εἰς ἑαυτοὺς ἀντιλογίαν, ἵνα μὴ κάμητε ταῖς ψυχαῖς ὑμῶν ἐκλυόμενοι.

text_en: For you have not yet resisted unto blood, striving against sin .
text_la: Nondum enim usque ad sanguinem restitistis, adversus peccatum repugnantes:
text_pt: Ainda não resististes até ao sangue, combatendo contra o pecado.
text_el: Οὔπω μέχρις αἵματος ἀντικατέστητε πρὸς τὴν ἁμαρτίαν ἀνταγωνιζόμενοι,

text_en: And you have forgotten the consolation which speaks to you, as unto children, saying: My son, neglect not the discipline of the Lord : neither be wearied whilst you are rebuked by him.
text_la: et obliti estis consolationis, quæ vobis tamquam filiis loquitur, dicens : Fili mi, noli negligere disciplinam Domini : neque fatigeris dum ab eo argueris.
text_pt: E já vos esquecestes da exortação que argumenta convosco como filhos: Filho meu, não desprezes a correção do Senhor, E não desmaies quando por ele fores repreendido;
text_el: καὶ ἐκλέλησθε τῆς παρακλήσεως, ἥτις ὑμῖν ὡς υἱοῖς διαλέγεται, υἱέ μου, μὴ ὀλιγώρει παιδείας κυρίου, μηδὲ ἐκλύου ὑπ' αὐτοῦ ἐλεγχόμενος:

text_en: For whom the Lord loves he chastises: and he scourges every son whom he receives.
text_la: Quem enim diligit Dominus, castigat : flagellat autem omnem filium, quem recipit.
text_pt: Porque o Senhor corrige o que ama,E açoita a qualquer que recebe por filho.
text_el: ὃν γὰρ ἀγαπᾷ κύριος παιδεύει, μαστιγοῖ δὲ πάντα υἱὸν ὃν παραδέχεται.

text_en: Persevere under discipline . God deals with you as with his sons . For what son is there whom the father does not correct?
text_la: In disciplina perseverate. Tamquam filiis vobis offert se Deus : quis enim filius, quem non corripit pater?
text_pt: Se suportais a correção, Deus vos trata como filhos; porque, que filho há a quem o pai não corrija?
text_el: εἰς παιδείαν ὑπομένετε: ὡς υἱοῖς ὑμῖν προσφέρεται ὁ θεός: τίς γὰρ υἱὸς ὃν οὐ παιδεύει πατήρ;

text_en: But if you be without chastisement, whereof all are made partakers , then are you bastards and not sons .
text_la: quod si extra disciplinam estis, cujus participes facti sunt omnes : ergo adulteri, et non filii estis.
text_pt: Mas, se estais sem disciplina, da qual todos são feitos participantes, sois então bastardos, e não filhos.
text_el: εἰ δὲ χωρίς ἐστε παιδείας, ἧς μέτοχοι γεγόνασιν πάντες, ἄρα νόθοι καὶ οὐχ υἱοί ἐστε.

text_en: Moreover, we have had fathers of our flesh for instructors, and we reverenced them. Shall we not much more obey the Father of spirits and live?
text_la: Deinde patres quidem carnis nostræ, eruditores habuimus, et reverebamur eos, non multo magis obtemperabimus Patri spirituum, et vivemus?
text_pt: Além do que, tivemos nossos pais segundo a carne, para nos corrigirem, e nós os reverenciamos; não nos sujeitaremos muito mais ao Pai dos espíritos, para vivermos?
text_el: εἶτα τοὺς μὲν τῆς σαρκὸς ἡμῶν πατέρας εἴχομεν παιδευτὰς καὶ ἐνετρεπόμεθα: οὐ πολὺ μᾶλλον ὑποταγησόμεθα τῷ πατρὶ τῶν πνευμάτων καὶ ζήσομεν;

text_en: And they indeed for a few days, according to their own pleasure, instructed us: but he, for our profit, that we might receive his sanctification .
text_la: Et illi quidem in tempore paucorum dierum, secundum voluntatem suam erudiebant nos : hic autem ad id quod utile est in recipiendo sanctificationem ejus.
text_pt: Porque aqueles, na verdade, por um pouco de tempo, nos corrigiam como bem lhes parecia; mas este, para nosso proveito, para sermos participantes da sua santidade.
text_el: οἱ μὲν γὰρ πρὸς ὀλίγας ἡμέρας κατὰ τὸ δοκοῦν αὐτοῖς ἐπαίδευον, ὁ δὲ ἐπὶ τὸ συμφέρον εἰς τὸ μεταλαβεῖν τῆς ἁγιότητος αὐτοῦ.

text_en: Now all chastisement for the present indeed seems not to bring with it joy , but sorrow: but afterwards it will yield to them that are exercised by it the most peaceable fruit of justice .
text_la: Omnis autem disciplina in præsenti quidem videtur non esse gaudii, sed mœroris : postea autem fructum pacatissimum exercitatis per eam, reddet justitiæ.
text_pt: E, na verdade, toda a correção, ao presente, não parece ser de gozo, senão de tristeza, mas depois produz um fruto pacífico de justiça nos exercitados por ela.
text_el: πᾶσα μὲν παιδεία πρὸς μὲν τὸ παρὸν οὐ δοκεῖ χαρᾶς εἶναι ἀλλὰ λύπης, ὕστερον δὲ καρπὸν εἰρηνικὸν τοῖς δι' αὐτῆς γεγυμνασμένοις ἀποδίδωσιν δικαιοσύνης.

text_en: Wherefore, lift up the hands which hang down and the feeble knees:
text_la: Propter quod remissas manus, et soluta genua erigite,
text_pt: Portanto, tornai a levantar as mãos cansadas, e os joelhos desconjuntados,
text_el: Διὸ τὰς παρειμένας χεῖρας καὶ τὰ παραλελυμένα γόνατα ἀνορθώσατε,

text_en: And make straight steps with your feet: that no one, halting, may go out of the way; but rather be healed.
text_la: et gressus rectos facite pedibus vestris : ut non claudicans quis erret, magis autem sanetur.
text_pt: E fazei veredas direitas para os vossos pés, para que o que manqueja não se desvie inteiramente, antes seja sarado.
text_el: καὶ τροχιὰς ὀρθὰς ποιεῖτε τοῖς ποσὶν ὑμῶν, ἵνα μὴ τὸ χωλὸν ἐκτραπῇ, ἰαθῇ δὲ μᾶλλον.

text_en: Follow peace with all men and holiness : without which no man shall see God .
text_la: Pacem sequimini cum omnibus, et sanctimoniam, sine qua nemo videbit Deum:
text_pt: Segui a paz com todos, e a santificação, sem a qual ninguém verá o Senhor;
text_el: εἰρήνην διώκετε μετὰ πάντων, καὶ τὸν ἁγιασμόν, οὗ χωρὶς οὐδεὶς ὄψεται τὸν κύριον,

text_en: Looking diligently, lest any man be wanting to the grace of God : lest any root of bitterness springing up do hinder and by it many be defiled:
text_la: contemplantes nequis desit gratiæ Dei : ne qua radix amaritudinis sursum germinans impediat, et per illam inquinentur multi.
text_pt: Tendo cuidado de que ninguém se prive da graça de Deus, e de que nenhuma raiz de amargura, brotando, vos perturbe, e por ela muitos se contaminem.
text_el: ἐπισκοποῦντες μή τις ὑστερῶν ἀπὸ τῆς χάριτος τοῦ θεοῦ, μή τις ῥίζα πικρίας ἄνω φύουσα ἐνοχλῇ καὶ δι' αὐτῆς μιανθῶσιν οἱ πολλοί,

text_en: Lest there be any fornicator or profane person, as Esau who for one mess sold his first birthright.
text_la: Ne quis fornicator, aut profanus ut Esau : qui propter unam escam vendidit primitiva sua:
text_pt: E ninguém seja devasso, ou profano, como Esaú, que por uma refeição vendeu o seu direito de primogenitura.
text_el: μή τις πόρνος ἢ βέβηλος ὡς Ἠσαῦ, ὃς ἀντὶ βρώσεως μιᾶς ἀπέδετο τὰ πρωτοτόκια ἑαυτοῦ.

text_en: For know that afterwards, when he desired to inherit the benediction , he was rejected. For he found no place of repentance, although with tears he had sought it.
text_la: scitote enim quoniam et postea cupiens hæreditare benedictionem, reprobatus est : non enim invenit pœnitentiæ locum, quamquam cum lacrimis inquisisset eam.
text_pt: Porque bem sabeis que, querendo ele ainda depois herdar a bênção, foi rejeitado, porque não achou lugar de arrependimento, ainda que com lágrimas o buscou.
text_el: ἴστε γὰρ ὅτι καὶ μετέπειτα θέλων κληρονομῆσαι τὴν εὐλογίαν ἀπεδοκιμάσθη, μετανοίας γὰρ τόπον οὐχ εὗρεν, καίπερ μετὰ δακρύων ἐκζητήσας αὐτήν.

text_en: For you are not come to a mountain that might be touched and a burning fire and a whirlwind and darkness and storm,
text_la: Non enim accessistis ad tractabilem montem, et accensibilem ignem, et turbinem, et caliginem, et procellam,
text_pt: Porque não chegastes ao monte palpável, aceso em fogo, e à escuridão, e às trevas, e à tempestade,
text_el: Οὐ γὰρ προσεληλύθατε ψηλαφωμένῳ καὶ κεκαυμένῳ πυρὶ καὶ γνόφῳ καὶ ζόφῳ καὶ θυέλλῃ

text_en: and the sound of a trumpet and the voice of words, which they that had excused themselves, that the word might not be spoken to them.
text_la: et tubæ sonum, et vocem verborum, quam qui audierunt, excusaverunt se, ne eis fieret verbum.
text_pt: E ao sonido da trombeta, e à voz das palavras, a qual os que a ouviram pediram que se lhes não falasse mais;
text_el: καὶ σάλπιγγος ἤχῳ καὶ φωνῇ ῥημάτων, ἧς οἱ ἀκούσαντες παρῃτήσαντο προστεθῆναι αὐτοῖς λόγον:

text_en: For they did not endure that which was said: and if so much as a beast shall touch the mount, it shall be stoned .
text_la: Non enim portabant quod dicebatur : Et si bestia tetigerit montem, lapidabitur.
text_pt: Porque não podiam suportar o que se lhes mandava: Se até um animal tocar o monte será apedrejado ou passado com um dardo.
text_el: οὐκ ἔφερον γὰρ τὸ διαστελλόμενον, κἂν θηρίον θίγῃ τοῦ ὄρους, λιθοβοληθήσεται:

text_en: And so terrible was that which was seen, Moses said: I am frighted , and tremble.
text_la: Et ita terribile erat quod videbatur. Moyses dixit : Exterritus sum, et tremebundus.
text_pt: E tão terrível era a visão, que Moisés disse: Estou todo assombrado, e tremendo.
text_el: καί, οὕτω φοβερὸν ἦν τὸ φανταζόμενον, Μωϋσῆς εἶπεν: ἔκφοβός εἰμι καὶ ἔντρομος.

text_en: But you have come to mount Sion and to the city of the living God , the heavenly Jerusalem , and to the company of many thousands of angels ,
text_la: Sed accessistis ad Sion montem, et civitatem Dei viventis, Jerusalem cælestem, et multorum millium angelorum frequentiam,
text_pt: Mas chegastes ao monte Sião, e à cidade do Deus vivo, à Jerusalém celestial, e aos muitos milhares de anjos;
text_el: ἀλλὰ προσεληλύθατε Σιὼν ὄρει καὶ πόλει θεοῦ ζῶντος, Ἰερουσαλὴμ ἐπουρανίῳ, καὶ μυριάσιν ἀγγέλων πανηγύρει,

text_en: and to the church of the firstborn who are written in the heavens , and to God the judge of all, and to the spirits of the just made perfect ,
text_la: et ecclesiam primitivorum, qui conscripti sunt in cælis, et judicem omnium Deum, et spiritus justorum perfectorum,
text_pt: À universal assembléia e igreja dos primogênitos, que estão inscritos nos céus, e a Deus, o juiz de todos, e aos espíritos dos justos aperfeiçoados;
text_el: καὶ ἐκκλησίᾳ πρωτοτόκων ἀπογεγραμμένων ἐν οὐρανοῖς, καὶ κριτῇ θεῷ πάντων, καὶ πνεύμασι δικαίων τετελειωμένων,

text_en: and to Jesus the mediator of the new testament, and to the sprinkling of blood which speaks better than that of Abel .
text_la: et testamenti novi mediatorem Jesum, et sanguinis aspersionem melius loquentem quam Abel.
text_pt: E a Jesus, o Mediador de uma nova aliança, e ao sangue da aspersão, que fala melhor do que o de Abel.
text_el: καὶ διαθήκης νέας μεσίτῃ Ἰησοῦ, καὶ αἵματι ῥαντισμοῦ κρεῖττον λαλοῦντι παρὰ τὸν Ἅβελ.

text_en: See that you refuse him not that speaks. For if they escaped not who refused him that spoke upon earth, much more shall not we that turn away from him that speaks to us from heaven .
text_la: Videte ne recusetis loquentem. Si enim illi non effugerunt, recusantes eum, qui super terram loquebatur : multo magis nos, qui de cælis loquentem nobis avertimus.
text_pt: Vede que não rejeiteis ao que fala; porque, se não escaparam aqueles que rejeitaram o que na terra os advertia, muito menos nós, se nos desviarmos daquele que é dos céus;
text_el: βλέπετε μὴ παραιτήσησθε τὸν λαλοῦντα: εἰ γὰρ ἐκεῖνοι οὐκ ἐξέφυγον ἐπὶ γῆς παραιτησάμενοι τὸν χρηματίζοντα, πολὺ μᾶλλον ἡμεῖς οἱ τὸν ἀπ' οὐρανῶν ἀποστρεφόμενοι:

text_en: Whose voice then moved the earth; but now he promises , saying: Yet once more: and I will move, not only the earth, but heaven also.
text_la: Cujus vox movit terram tunc : nunc autem repromittit, dicens : Adhuc semel, et ego movebo non solum terram, sed et cælum.
text_pt: A voz do qual moveu então a terra, mas agora anunciou, dizendo: Ainda uma vez comoverei, não só a terra, senão também o céu.
text_el: οὗ ἡ φωνὴ τὴν γῆν ἐσάλευσεν τότε, νῦν δὲ ἐπήγγελται λέγων, ἔτι ἅπαξ ἐγὼ σείσω οὐ μόνον τὴν γῆν ἀλλὰ καὶ τὸν οὐρανόν.

text_en: And in that he says: Yet once more, he signifies the translation of the moveable things as made, that those things may remain which are immoveable.
text_la: Quod autem, Adhuc semel, dicit : declarat mobilium translationem tamquam factorum, ut maneant ea quæ sunt immobilia.
text_pt: E esta palavra: Ainda uma vez, mostra a mudança das coisas móveis, como coisas feitas, para que as imóveis permaneçam.
text_el: τὸ δέ, ἔτι ἅπαξ δηλοῖ τὴν τῶν σαλευομένων μετάθεσιν ὡς πεποιημένων, ἵνα μείνῃ τὰ μὴ σαλευόμενα.

text_en: Therefore, receiving an immoveable kingdom , we have grace : whereby let us serve, pleasing God , with fear and reverence .
text_la: Itaque regnum immobile suscipientes, habemus gratiam : per quam serviamus placentes Deo, cum metu et reverentia.
text_pt: Por isso, tendo recebido um reino que não pode ser abalado, retenhamos a graça, pela qual sirvamos a Deus agradavelmente, com reverência e piedade;
text_el: διὸ βασιλείαν ἀσάλευτον παραλαμβάνοντες ἔχωμεν χάριν, δι' ἧς λατρεύωμεν εὐαρέστως τῷ θεῷ μετὰ εὐλαβείας καὶ δέους:

text_en: For our God is a consuming fire.
text_la: Etenim Deus noster ignis consumens est.
text_pt: Porque o nosso Deus é um fogo consumidor.
text_el: καὶ γὰρ ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν πῦρ καταναλίσκον.

text_en: Let the charity of the brotherhood abide in you.
text_la: Caritas fraternitatis maneat in vobis,
text_pt: Permaneça o amor fraternal.
text_el: Ἡ φιλαδελφία μενέτω.

text_en: And hospitality do not forget: for by this some, being not aware of it, have entertained angels .
text_la: et hospitalitatem nolite oblivisci : per hanc enim latuerunt quidam, angelis hospitio receptis.
text_pt: Não vos esqueçais da hospitalidade, porque por ela alguns, não o sabendo, hospedaram anjos.
text_el: τῆς φιλοξενίας μὴ ἐπιλανθάνεσθε: διὰ ταύτης γὰρ ἔλαθόν τινες ξενίσαντες ἀγγέλους.

text_en: Remember them that are in bands, as if you were bound with them: and them that labour, as being yourselves also in the body.
text_la: Mementote vinctorum, tamquam simul vincti : et laborantium, tamquam et ipsi in corpore morantes.
text_pt: Lembrai-vos dos presos, como se estivésseis presos com eles, e dos maltratados, como sendo-o vós mesmos também no corpo.
text_el: μιμνῄσκεσθε τῶν δεσμίων ὡς συνδεδεμένοι, τῶν κακουχουμένων ὡς καὶ αὐτοὶ ὄντες ἐν σώματι.

text_en: Marriage honourable in all, and the bed undefiled. For fornicators and adulterers God will judge .
text_la: Honorabile connubium in omnibus, et thorus immaculatus. Fornicatores enim, et adulteros judicabit Deus.
text_pt: Venerado seja entre todos o matrimônio e o leito sem mácula; porém, aos que se dão à prostituição, e aos adúlteros, Deus os julgará.
text_el: τίμιος ὁ γάμος ἐν πᾶσιν καὶ ἡ κοίτη ἀμίαντος, πόρνους γὰρ καὶ μοιχοὺς κρινεῖ ὁ θεός.

text_en: Let your manners be without covetousness , contented with such things as you have. For he has said: I will not leave you: neither will I forsake you.
text_la: Sint mores sine avaritia, contenti præsentibus : ipse enim dixit : Non te deseram, neque derelinquam:
text_pt: Sejam vossos costumes sem avareza, contentando-vos com o que tendes; porque ele disse: Não te deixarei, nem te desampararei.
text_el: ἀφιλάργυρος ὁ τρόπος, ἀρκούμενοι τοῖς παροῦσιν: αὐτὸς γὰρ εἴρηκεν, οὐ μή σε ἀνῶ οὐδ' οὐ μή σε ἐγκαταλίπω,

text_en: So that we may confidently say: The Lord is my helper: I will not fear what man shall do to me.
text_la: ita ut confidenter dicamus : Dominus mihi adjutor : non timebo quid faciat mihi homo.
text_pt: E assim com confiança ousemos dizer: O Senhor é o meu ajudador, e não temerei O que me possa fazer o homem.
text_el: ὥστε θαρροῦντας ἡμᾶς λέγειν, κύριος ἐμοὶ βοηθός, οὐ φοβηθήσομαι: τί ποιήσει μοι ἄνθρωπος;

text_en: Remember your prelates who have spoken the word of God to you: whose faith follow, considering the end of their conversation,
text_la: Mementote præpositorum vestrorum, qui vobis locuti sunt verbum Dei : quorum intuentes exitum conversationis, imitamini fidem.
text_pt: Lembrai-vos dos vossos pastores, que vos falaram a palavra de Deus, a fé dos quais imitai, atentando para a sua maneira de viver.
text_el: Μνημονεύετε τῶν ἡγουμένων ὑμῶν, οἵτινες ἐλάλησαν ὑμῖν τὸν λόγον τοῦ θεοῦ, ὧν ἀναθεωροῦντες τὴν ἔκβασιν τῆς ἀναστροφῆς μιμεῖσθε τὴν πίστιν.

text_en: Jesus Christ , yesterday, and today: and the same for ever.
text_la: Jesus Christus heri, et hodie : ipse et in sæcula.
text_pt: Jesus Cristo é o mesmo, ontem, e hoje, e eternamente.
text_el: Ἰησοῦς Χριστὸς ἐχθὲς καὶ σήμερον ὁ αὐτός, καὶ εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας.

text_en: Be not led away with various and strange doctrines . For it is best that the heart be established with grace , not with meats: which have not profited those that walk in them.
text_la: Doctrinis variis et peregrinis nolite abduci. Optimum est enim gratia stabilire cor, non escis : quæ non profuerunt ambulantibus in eis.
text_pt: Não vos deixeis levar em redor por doutrinas várias e estranhas, porque bom é que o coração se fortifique com graça, e não com alimentos que de nada aproveitaram aos que a eles se entregaram.
text_el: διδαχαῖς ποικίλαις καὶ ξέναις μὴ παραφέρεσθε: καλὸν γὰρ χάριτι βεβαιοῦσθαι τὴν καρδίαν, οὐ βρώμασιν, ἐν οἷς οὐκ ὠφελήθησαν οἱ περιπατοῦντες.

text_en: We have an altar whereof they have no power to eat who serve the tabernacle .
text_la: Habemus altare, de quo edere non habent potestatem, qui tabernaculo deserviunt.
text_pt: Temos um altar, de que não têm direito de comer os que servem ao tabernáculo.
text_el: Ἔχομεν θυσιαστήριον ἐξ οὗ φαγεῖν οὐκ ἔχουσιν [ἐξουσίαν] οἱ τῇ σκηνῇ λατρεύοντες.

text_en: For the bodies of those beasts whose blood is brought into the holies by the high priest for sin are burned without the camp.
text_la: Quorum enim animalium infertur sanguis pro peccato in Sancta per pontificem, horum corpora cremantur extra castra.
text_pt: Porque os corpos dos animais, cujo sangue é, pelo pecado, trazido pelo sumo sacerdote para o santuário, são queimados fora do arraial.
text_el: ὧν γὰρ εἰσφέρεται ζῴων τὸ αἷμα περὶ ἁμαρτίας εἰς τὰ ἅγια διὰ τοῦ ἀρχιερέως, τούτων τὰ σώματα κατακαίεται ἔξω τῆς παρεμβολῆς.

text_en: Wherefore Jesus also, that he might sanctify the people by his own blood, suffered without the gate.
text_la: Propter quod et Jesus, ut sanctificaret per suum sanguinem populum, extra portam passus est.
text_pt: E por isso também Jesus, para santificar o povo pelo seu próprio sangue, padeceu fora da porta.
text_el: διὸ καὶ Ἰησοῦς, ἵνα ἁγιάσῃ διὰ τοῦ ἰδίου αἵματος τὸν λαόν, ἔξω τῆς πύλης ἔπαθεν.

text_en: Let us go forth therefore to him without the camp, bearing his reproach.
text_la: Exeamus igitur ad eum extra castra, improperium ejus portantes.
text_pt: Saiamos, pois, a ele fora do arraial, levando o seu vitupério.
text_el: τοίνυν ἐξερχώμεθα πρὸς αὐτὸν ἔξω τῆς παρεμβολῆς, τὸν ὀνειδισμὸν αὐτοῦ φέροντες:

text_en: For, we have not here a lasting city: but we seek one that is to come.
text_la: Non enim habemus hic manentem civitatem, sed futuram inquirimus.
text_pt: Porque não temos aqui cidade permanente, mas buscamos a futura.
text_el: οὐ γὰρ ἔχομεν ὧδε μένουσαν πόλιν, ἀλλὰ τὴν μέλλουσαν ἐπιζητοῦμεν.

text_en: By him therefore let us offer the sacrifice of praise always to God , that is to say, the fruit of lips confessing to his name.
text_la: Per ipsum ergo offeramus hostiam laudis semper Deo, id est, fructum labiorum confitentium nomini ejus.
text_pt: Portanto, ofereçamos sempre por ele a Deus sacrifício de louvor, isto é, o fruto dos lábios que confessam o seu nome.
text_el: Δι' αὐτοῦ ἀναφέρωμεν θυσίαν αἰνέσεως διὰ παντὸς τῷ θεῷ, τοῦτ' ἔστιν καρπὸν χειλέων ὁμολογούντων τῷ ὀνόματι αὐτοῦ.

text_en: And do not forget to do good and to impart: for by such sacrifices God's favour is obtained.
text_la: Beneficentiæ autem et communionis nolite oblivisci : talibus enim hostiis promeretur Deus.
text_pt: E não vos esqueçais da beneficência e comunicação, porque com tais sacrifícios Deus se agrada.
text_el: τῆς δὲ εὐποιΐας καὶ κοινωνίας μὴ ἐπιλανθάνεσθε, τοιαύταις γὰρ θυσίαις εὐαρεστεῖται ὁ θεός.

text_en: Obey your prelates and be subject to them. For they watch as being to render an account of your souls : that they may do this with joy and not with grief. For this is not expedient for you.
text_la: Obedite præpositis vestris, et subjacete eis. Ipsi enim pervigilant quasi rationem pro animabus vestris reddituri, ut cum gaudio hoc faciant, et non gementes : hoc enim non expedit vobis.
text_pt: Obedecei a vossos pastores, e sujeitai-vos a eles; porque velam por vossas almas, como aqueles que hão de dar conta delas; para que o façam com alegria e não gemendo, porque isso não vos seria útil.
text_el: Πείθεσθε τοῖς ἡγουμένοις ὑμῶν καὶ ὑπείκετε, αὐτοὶ γὰρ ἀγρυπνοῦσιν ὑπὲρ τῶν ψυχῶν ὑμῶν ὡς λόγον ἀποδώσοντες, ἵνα μετὰ χαρᾶς τοῦτο ποιῶσιν καὶ μὴ στενάζοντες, ἀλυσιτελὲς γὰρ ὑμῖν τοῦτο.

text_en: Pray for us. For we trust we have a good conscience , being willing to behave ourselves well in all things.
text_la: Orate pro nobis: confidimus enim quia bonam conscientiam habemus in omnibus bene volentes conversari.
text_pt: Orai por nós, porque confiamos que temos boa consciência, como aqueles que em tudo querem portar-se honestamente.
text_el: Προσεύχεσθε περὶ ἡμῶν, πειθόμεθα γὰρ ὅτι καλὴν συνείδησιν ἔχομεν, ἐν πᾶσιν καλῶς θέλοντες ἀναστρέφεσθαι.

text_en: And I beseech you the more to do this, that I may be restored to you the sooner.
text_la: Amplius autem deprecor vos hoc facere, quo celerius restituar vobis.
text_pt: E rogo-vos com instância que assim o façais, para que eu mais depressa vos seja restituído.
text_el: περισσοτέρως δὲ παρακαλῶ τοῦτο ποιῆσαι ἵνα τάχιον ἀποκατασταθῶ ὑμῖν.

text_en: And may the God of peace, who brought again from the dead the great pastor of the sheep, our Lord Jesus Christ , in the blood of the everlasting testament,
text_la: Deus autem pacis, qui eduxit de mortuis pastorem magnum ovium, in sanguine testamenti æterni, Dominum nostrum Jesum Christum,
text_pt: Ora, o Deus de paz, que pelo sangue da aliança eterna tornou a trazer dos mortos a nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo, grande pastor das ovelhas,
text_el: Ὁ δὲ θεὸς τῆς εἰρήνης, ὁ ἀναγαγὼν ἐκ νεκρῶν τὸν ποιμένα τῶν προβάτων τὸν μέγαν ἐν αἵματι διαθήκης αἰωνίου, τὸν κύριον ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦν,

text_en: fit you in all goodness , that you may do his will; doing in you that which is well pleasing in his sight, through Jesus Christ , to whom is glory for ever and ever. Amen .
text_la: aptet vos in omni bono, ut faciatis ejus voluntatem : faciens in vobis quod placeat coram se per Jesum Christum : cui est gloria in sæcula sæculorum. Amen.
text_pt: Vos aperfeiçoe em toda a boa obra, para fazerdes a sua vontade, operando em vós o que perante ele é agradável por Cristo Jesus, ao qual seja glória para todo o sempre. Amém.
text_el: καταρτίσαι ὑμᾶς ἐν παντὶ ἀγαθῷ εἰς τὸ ποιῆσαι τὸ θέλημα αὐτοῦ, ποιῶν ἐν ἡμῖν τὸ εὐάρεστον ἐνώπιον αὐτοῦ διὰ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ, ᾧ ἡ δόξα εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων: ἀμήν.

text_en: And I beseech you, brethren, that you suffer this word of consolation. For I have written to you in a few words.
text_la: Rogo autem vos fratres, ut sufferatis verbum solatii. Etenim perpaucis scripsi vobis.
text_pt: Rogo-vos, porém, irmãos, que suporteis a palavra desta exortação; porque abreviadamente vos escrevi.
text_el: Παρακαλῶ δὲ ὑμᾶς, ἀδελφοί, ἀνέχεσθε τοῦ λόγου τῆς παρακλήσεως, καὶ γὰρ διὰ βραχέων ἐπέστειλα ὑμῖν.

text_en: Know that our brother Timothy is set at liberty: with whom (if he come shortly) I will see you.
text_la: Cognoscite fratrem nostrum Timotheum dimissum : cum quo (si celerius venerit) videbo vos.
text_pt: Sabei que já está solto o irmão Timóteo, com o qual, se ele vier depressa, vos verei.
text_el: γινώσκετε τὸν ἀδελφὸν ἡμῶν Τιμόθεον ἀπολελυμένον, μεθ' οὗ ἐὰν τάχιον ἔρχηται ὄψομαι ὑμᾶς.

text_en: Salute all your prelates and all the saints . The brethren from Italy salute you.
text_la: Salutate omnes præpositos vestros, et omnes sanctos. Salutant vos de Italia fratres.
text_pt: Saudai a todos os vossos chefes e a todos os santos. Os da Itália vos saúdam.
text_el: ἀσπάσασθε πάντας τοὺς ἡγουμένους ὑμῶν καὶ πάντας τοὺς ἁγίους. ἀσπάζονται ὑμᾶς οἱ ἀπὸ τῆς Ἰταλίας.

text_en: Grace be with you all. Amen .
text_la: Gratia cum omnibus vobis. Amen.
text_pt: A graça seja com todos vós. Amém.
text_el: Ἡ χάρις μετὰ πάντων ὑμῶν.
